entries.zh: 似乎有第三方恶意入侵了驻在[Root.Capital.GetName]的[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使，[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果不同于平日宽宏的陈词滥调，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]开始恶毒地羞辱，把众人骂了个遍。[event_envoy.GetHerHis]设备的故障已被及时查明，但在此之前[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]已经被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”——他们肯定会对这种严重羞辱加以回应。
entries.en: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of the [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy to [Root.Capital.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that instead of uttering magnanimous platitudes, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] began spewing vicious insults that left none unscathed. The malfunction in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] equipment was duly uncovered, but not before [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]" - a grave insult which surely calls for a response.

entries.zh: 似乎有第三方恶意入侵了我们派往[From.GetName]的特使[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原本宽宏的外交辞令变成了恶毒的羞辱，把众人骂了个遍——尤其是他们的[From.GetRulerTitle]，被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”。
entries.en: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of our envoy to the [From.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] magnanimous platitudes instead became vicious insults that left none unscathed - not least their [From.GetRulerTitle], who was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]".

entries.zh: $envoy_events.2.desc.base$\n\n幸好，故障被迅速查明，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对这个事故报以幽默。不过“[Root.GetAdj]特使不当行为”的记录广为流传，在他国人民中被引为笑谈。
entries.en: $envoy_events.2.desc.base$\n\nFortunately, the malfunction was swiftly uncovered and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took the incident with a sense of humor. Indeed, recordings of the "inappropriate [Root.GetAdj] envoy" are circulating widely, causing much mirth among their people.

entries.zh: $envoy_events.2.desc.base$\n\n尽管故障被迅速查明，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不觉得这个事故好笑，并且正式控诉了我国特使的不当行为。
entries.en: $envoy_events.2.desc.base$\n\nAlthough the malfunction was swiftly uncovered, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not amused at the incident and have lodged an official complaint at the inappropriate behavior of our envoy.

entries.zh: 真是对[From.GetAdj]社会的高贵贡献。
一名外国特使的不当行动在我们社会中传为笑谈。
entries.en: The misendeavors of a foreign envoy have provoked much mirth in our society.

entries.zh: [event_envoy.GetName]，我们在星海共同体中代表我国利益的使者严重失态，把[council_country.GetAdj]代表错当成了[pathetic_country.GetSpeciesName]。不幸的是，许多旁观者听到了这条牵连甚广的评论，[event_envoy.GetName]如今自然饱受奚落。
entries.en: [event_envoy.GetName], our emissary representing our interests in the Galactic Community, has committed a major faux pas, mistaking the [council_country.GetAdj] delegate for a [pathetic_country.GetSpeciesName]. Unfortunately, the incriminating remarks were witnessed by many onlookers, who duly showered [event_envoy.GetName] with ridicule.

entries.zh: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$许多人开始中伤我国外交使团的实力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
entries.en: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic corps, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.

entries.zh: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$许多人开始中伤我国外交思维个体的竞争力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
entries.en: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic thought routines, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.

entries.zh: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$许多人开始中伤我国外交系统的实力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
entries.en: $envoy_events.3.desc.base$ Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic systems, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.

entries.zh: 随他们笑吧，趁他们还笑得出声。
entries.en: Let them laugh while they may.

entries.zh: 我们的一名特使严重失态，致使我国的外交使团变成了整个星系的笑料。
entries.en: One of our envoys has committed a major faux pas, making our diplomatic corps the laughing stock of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 尽管我们在星系中算不上真正的超级大国，我们却时常能在星系事务中发挥超过我国权重的实力。这在很大程度上归功于我们使者[event_envoy.GetName]的努力，这名特使在星海共同体中称职地代表了我国利益，连那些强硬反对[Root.GetName]立场的人们也对其高度尊敬。
entries.en: Although we are not able to count ourselves among the true superpowers of this galaxy, we have often been able to punch above our weight in galactic affairs. This is largely down to the exertions of our emissary [event_envoy.GetName], who ably represents our interests in the Galactic Community and commands deep respect even among those stridently opposed to all the [Root.GetName] stands for.

entries.zh: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的金库，但他们依然景仰我国外交使团的高超造诣。
entries.en: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the depths of our coffers, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic corps.

entries.zh: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的物质资源，但他们依然景仰我国外交思维个体的高超造诣。
entries.en: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the extent of our material resources, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic thought routines.

entries.zh: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的物质资源，但他们依然景仰我国外交思维系统的高超造诣。
entries.en: $envoy_events.4.desc.base$ As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the extent of our material resources, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic thought systems.

entries.zh: 我国的外交使团在全星系感性物种间广受尊敬。
entries.en: Our diplomatic corps are widely respected among the sentient species of the galaxy.

entries.zh: [envoy_source.GetAdj]特使[event_envoy.GetName]在[Root.Capital.GetName]上代表[envoy_source.GetAdj]利益的方式恼人又令人厌倦。自[event_envoy.GetHerHis]初来这里，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就始终对[Root.GetGovernmentName]满怀敌意，对我国的政策和行动几乎持续不断地加以反对。[event_envoy.GetSheHe]实在太过烦人，如果能摆脱掉[event_envoy.GetHerHim]，没几个人会不开心的，而且我们已经收到传言，说一个[Root.GetAdj]忠诚者团体正阴谋加速[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的离世。\n\n允许这项阴谋继续下去当然十分容易，但让外国要人在我国境内被刺杀或许算不得什么好事。
entries.en: The [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has been exasperatingly tiresome in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] efforts to represent [envoy_source.GetAdj] interests in [Root.Capital.GetName]. Right from [event_envoy.GetHerHis] first arrival, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] shown unremitting hostility towards the [Root.GetGovernmentName], unleashing an almost constant barrage of objections to our policies and actions. So great an irritation [event_envoy.GetHasHave] [event_envoy.GetSheHe] been that few would weep to see the back of [event_envoy.GetHerHim], and we have heard whispers that a group of [Root.GetAdj] loyalists are plotting to expedite [event_envoy.GetHerHis] demise.\n\nAllowing this scheme to succeed would certainly be convenient, but allowing foreign dignitaries to be assassinated in our realm might not be the best of looks.

entries.zh: 我们不能对此坐视不理。揪出这个阴谋！
entries.en: We will not stoop to such measures. Snuff out the plot!

entries.zh: 就让这个烦人的特使消失好了。
entries.en: Let us be rid of this troublesome envoy.

entries.zh: [event_envoy.GetName]——我国派去调解与[From.GetName]间争议的特使被谋杀了！[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]在几天前消失的无影无踪，错过了[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原计划与[Root.GetRulerTitle]议会进行的沟通。在搜索数日后，[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的遗体在一个即将被焚化的收纳箱中被发现。\n\n[From.GetAdj]政府推三阻四，不愿发起调查，让人怀疑他们是谋杀的幕后主使——尤其因为[event_envoy.GetName]近来对[From.GetGovernmentName]大加抨击。
entries.en: [event_envoy.GetName] - the envoy we sent to mediate our disagreements with the [From.GetName] - has been murdered! [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] disappeared without a trace several days ago, missing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] scheduled sync with the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s council. After several days of searching, [event_envoy.GetHerHis] remains were found in a storage container destined to be incinerated.\n\nThe [From.GetAdj] authorities have been strangely evasive when asked to investigate, arousing suspicions that they were behind the killing - especially since [event_envoy.GetName] had been highly critical of the [From.GetGovernmentName] in recent times.

entries.zh: 由于某种原因，外国特使在我国首都更容易猝然离世，这影响了我国在星海同侪中的地位。
entries.en: For some reason, foreign envoys' propensity to meet a sticky demise on our capital has affected our standing among our galactic peers.

entries.zh: 我国特使[event_envoy.GetName]似乎并未完成[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的任务，好好维护[Root.GetAdj]利益，反而与一名[other_species_nation.GetAdj]外交官堕入爱河。由于担忧如此逾矩可能招致的恶果，这对恋人私奔去了[third_party.GetName]：那个国家危险的自由主义宪法允许这样的结合。\n\n如此一来，[event_envoy.GetName]已丧失了我国给予[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的特使职位。但是，对我们自己的官员失去掌控损害了我们的星际地位。我们必须逮捕这名不法之徒，恢复我们的名誉！
entries.en: It seems that, instead of performing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] task and representing [Root.GetAdj] interests, our envoy [event_envoy.GetName] has fallen for the charms of a [other_species_nation.GetAdj] diplomat. Fearing the repercussions of this transgression, the pair have eloped to the [third_party.GetName]: a nation whose dangerously liberal constitution permits such unions.\n\nIn doing this, [event_envoy.GetName] has forfeited [event_envoy.GetHerHis] position as our envoy. However, this loss of control over our own officials has hurt our galactic standing. We must restore our reputation by apprehending the miscreant!

entries.zh: 找到他们，向他们晓之以理。
entries.en: Approach them and appeal to reason.

entries.zh: 如果[third_party.GetName]接受，我们会给予其2个外交支持。
entries.en: If the [third_party.GetName] accepts, we will owe them 2 Favors.

entries.zh: 随他们去吧；这件事很快就会过去的。
entries.en: Let it be; the affair will be forgotten soon enough.

entries.zh: 尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们注意到一名[From.GetAdj]罪犯正于贵国避难。这名不法之徒，亦即我国前特使[event_envoy.GetName]，背弃了一切效忠誓言，违反了我国最基本的法律，与一名[other_species_nation.GetAdj]私奔出逃。\n\n劳驾贵国将这名罪犯交还给我国，以便[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能因[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的罪行受到审判。
entries.en: Esteemed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! It has come to our attention that a [From.GetAdj] criminal has taken refuge in your nation. The miscreant, our former envoy [event_envoy.GetName], broke all bonds of loyalty - along with the most fundamental laws of our nation - to elope with a [other_species_nation.GetAdj].\n\nWe would kindly ask that the criminal be returned to us, so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face trial for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] crimes.

entries.zh: 当然可以！我们会将[event_envoy.GetName]即刻遣返。
entries.en: Of course! We will return [event_envoy.GetName] to you immediately.

entries.zh: 政治庇护于我们而言是神圣的。我方无法苟同你等的请求，交出那些没有做错任何事情的人们！
entries.en: Political asylum is sacred to us. We cannot countenance giving up those who have done no wrong to the likes of you!
We are saddened to hear this.

entries.zh: 派出一支特别行动队将这对恋人抓捕归案。\n[third_party.GetName]将会不满。
entries.en: Send a special ops team to retrieve the pair.\nThe [third_party.GetName] will be displeased.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]似乎对我们拒绝向他们引渡其逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]非常不满，结果他们决定自己解决这个问题。这名逃亡者在我们眼皮子底下被绑架走了，似乎是一支训练有素的特别行动队在夜深人静时干了这件事。\n\n我们未能保护那些寻求我们帮助的人们，这在我们的盟友间引起了不小的关注，我们的外交官正在试着收拾局面。
entries.en: It seems the [From.GetName] were so displeased by our refusal to extradite their rogue envoy [event_envoy.GetName] to them that they took matters into their own hands. The fugitive was stolen from under our noses at dead of night by what appears to have been a very well-drilled team of special operatives.\n\nOur inability to protect those who seek our aid has caused considerable concern among our allies, and our diplomats are scrambling to contain the situation.

entries.zh: 我们派去抓捕逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]的小队成功完成任务。这名罪犯已被安全地收监，等待[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的罪行招致的重惩。
entries.en: The team we sent to retrieve our rogue envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has successfully completed its mission. The criminal is now safely in our custody and faces a heavy punishment for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] sins.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]似乎对我们拒绝向他们引渡其逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]非常不满，结果他们打算自己解决这个问题，并发起了一项抓捕行动。不过，这项行动失败了，我们在[From.GetAdj]载有特别行动队员的舰船试图越过边境时将其拦截。同时我们也采取措施保证未来的企图也会以类似方式失败。
entries.en: It seems the [From.GetName] were so displeased by our refusal to extradite their rogue envoy [event_envoy.GetName] to them that they took matters into their own hands and launched a retrieval mission. However, this mission was bungled, as we intercepted the [From.GetAdj] vessel carrying their special operatives as it attempted to cross the border. Measures have been taken to ensure that future attempts will be similarly unsuccessful.

entries.zh: 我们派去抓捕逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]的小队未能完成任务；他们的舰船在试图越过边境时被抓到了[From.GetAdj]拘留点。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如预计中一般勃然大怒，抨击[Root.GetAdj]对他们事务的干涉。在他们看来，我国公民一定因我们对这件事的处理及抓捕罪犯失败而灰心丧气。
entries.en: The team we sent to retrieve our rogue envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], was unsuccessful in its mission; their vessel was taken into [From.GetAdj] custody as they tried to cross the border. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are predictably incensed and are decrying [Root.GetAdj] interference in their affairs. For their part, our citizens are dismayed at our handling of the affair and our failure to retrieve the criminal.

entries.zh: 我国在同侪中的地位因我们未能保护已给予政治庇护的人们而有所下降。
entries.en: Our standing among our peers is tarnished by our failure to protect those we offered political asylum.

entries.zh: 我们未能抓回逃亡特使，这既给我们的星系同侪敲响了警钟，又动摇了我国公民对政府的信心。
entries.en: Our failed attempt to retrieve a rogue envoy has both alarmed our galactic peers and shaken the faith of our citizens in our government.

entries.zh: 我们在控制己方外交官时的无能不会激发同侪们的信心。
entries.en: Our inability to keep control of our own diplomats does not inspire confidence among our peers.

entries.zh: 我们派往星海共同体的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]，最近花在照料一只跟在[event_envoy.GetHerHim]身边的奇异小型哺乳动物的时间多到令人不安。想必这是某位其他代表的家庭宠物，它可爱非常，但没有任何开智的迹象。尽管它十分喜好肉食，牙尖爪利，总体上却温柔喜人，希望以抚摸的形式大量进行身体上的接触——可它的脾气有时会变得暴烈。\n\n尽管这只生物已被证明会让[event_envoy.GetName]从更为严肃的任务中分心，其他代表却对[Root.GetSpeciesName]心灵中柔软、感性、惹人爱慕的一面多加赞誉。
entries.en: [event_envoy.GetName], our emissary to the Galactic Community, has been spending a disturbing amount of time tending to a strange, small mammalian creature that began following [event_envoy.GetHerHim] around. Presumably a domestic pet that escaped from one of the other delegations, it is undeniably cute but shows no sign of sapient thought. Although it is highly carnivorous and exhibits sharp teeth and claws, it is generally affectionate and desires plentiful physical contact in the form of petting - though its mood swings can be sudden and violent!\n\nAlthough the creature has proved a distraction for [event_envoy.GetName]'s more serious tasks, other delegates have commented on the endearing nature of the softer, more sentimental side of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] psyche that has been revealed.

entries.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]近来的法律修订引起了不小的骚动，我国与[dispute_winner.GetName]间旧有的意识形态争论重新被推上前台。我国代表，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetName]，就我方立场大胆地与[dispute_winner.GetAdj]行政官[dispute_winner_envoy.GetName]进行了辩论。
entries.en: The recent law changes in the [Root.Federation.GetName] caused a significant stir, with old ideological debates between ourselves and the [dispute_winner.GetName] once again rising to the fore. Our representative, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetName], bravely represented our side of the debate against the [dispute_winner.GetAdj] official, [dispute_winner_envoy.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetGovernmentName]各处的公民饶有兴致地观看了整场辩论，并对如何将自己的理想与[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员国资格相调和愈发担忧。
entries.en: Citizens across the [Root.GetGovernmentName] watched the debate with interest, and are increasingly concerned about how to reconcile their ideals with membership in the [Root.Federation.GetName].

entries.zh: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于军国主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，辩论逐渐对[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim]变得不利，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]看起来愈发紧张，在场各方都在向[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim]指责“[Root.GetAdj]穷兵黩武”。\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more militaristic outlook, and as the debate turned against [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim], [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] appeared increasingly rattled as accusations of "[Root.GetAdj] warmongering" were made against [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim] from all sides.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于和平主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，与会的其他人员大声叫嚷，斥责“[Root.GetAdj]的幼稚无知”威胁到了整个联邦的安全。\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more pacifistic outlook, and faced vociferous retorts from all quarters that "[Root.GetAdj] naivety" allegedly threatens the safety of the entire federation.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于唯心主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，旁观者纷纷摇头反对，认为[Root.GetAdj]“迷信”十分“陈腐”。\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more spiritualist outlook, and witnesses were left shaking their head at the "backwardness" of [Root.GetAdj] "superstitions".\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于唯物主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，现场情势愈发紧张，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis]的同僚不断谴责[Root.GetAdj]“享乐主义”，坚持认为他们的迷信观念十分优越。\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more materialistic outlook, and grew increasingly rattled as [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] peers continued to decry [Root.GetAdj] "hedonism", insisting on the superiority of their superstitious ways.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于亲外主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis]的观点被断然谴责成“危险的自由主义”。\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more xenophilic outlook, with [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] outlook flatly condemned as "dangerously liberal".\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于排外主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis]关于我们应当留意外来影响的郑重声明被说成是空洞、陈腐的偏见。\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more xenophobic outlook, with [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHis] protestations that we should be wary of foreign influences decried as hollow and backwards prejudice.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于平等主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，那些生活在不太自由的社会中的人们看不到自由的好处，反而指责我们为“危险的自由主义”。\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more egalitarian outlook, as those living in less free societies failed to see the benefits that greater liberties would give them, instead accusing us of being "dangerously liberal".\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

entries.zh: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于威权主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，旁观者越来越觉得我们侵犯个人自由是一种罪恶。\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$
entries.en: $envoy_events.17.desc.base$ However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more authoritarian outlook, with witnesses increasingly convinced at the alleged evil of impinging on the liberties of the individual.\n\n$envoy_events.17.desc.end$

entries.en: We cannot compromise on our values.

entries.zh: 为了保持团结还是噤声为好。
entries.en: We shall keep our silence in the interest of unity.

entries.en: However, the [dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took this turn of events poorly, complaining at the encroachment on their values and expressing concern at the direction the federation is currently taking.

entries.en: was able to persuade many of the benefits of a more pacifistic outlook, demonstrating the dangers caused to us all by [dispute_loser.GetAdj] warmongering.

entries.en: was able to persuade many of the benefits of spiritualism, revealing for all to see the problems excessive materialism causes [dispute_loser.GetAdj] society.

entries.zh: 设法说服大多数人接受了唯物主义更有好处的见解，展示了[dispute_loser.GetAdj]唯心迷信的陈腐之处。
entries.en: was able to persuade many of the benefits of a materialist outlook, demonstrating the backwardness of [dispute_loser.GetAdj] spiritualist superstitions.

entries.zh: 设法说服大多数人接受了亲外主义更有好处的见解，在亲外的联邦中各物种相向而行，而非像[dispute_loser.GetAdj]特使[dispute_loser_envoy.GetName]所想要的那样长期互相猜忌。
entries.en: was able to convince many of the benefits of a xenophilic outlook, where all species in the federation seek to get along, rather than constantly being suspicious of our peers, as the [dispute_loser.GetAdj] envoy [dispute_loser_envoy.GetName] would have us be.

entries.zh: 设法说服大多数人接受了排外主义更有好处的见解，在排外的联邦中各成员国都把自己的利益放在首位，而非如[dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的乌托邦理想主义一般。
entries.en: was able to convince many of the benefits of a xenophobic outlook, where federation members look out for themselves first, rather than following the utopian idealism of the [dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 设法说服大多数人接受了平等主义更有好处的见解，在平等主义下人人皆平等，而让[dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural]朝不保夕的威权主义则是邪恶的，安全与否全靠上位者脸色。
entries.en: was able to convince many of the benefits of a more egalitarian outlook, where all are considered free and evil, safe from the predations of authoritarianism that many [dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural] suffer under.

entries.zh: 设法说服大多数人接受了威权主义更有好处的见解，在威权主义下法律与秩序得到遵行，我们可以远离[dispute_loser.GetAdj]关于平等的理想主义所引发的危险。
entries.en: was able to convince many of the benefits of a more authoritarian outlook, with a focus on law and order that would allow us to escape the dangers of [dispute_loser.GetAdj] idealism about equality.

entries.zh: 他们只是受不了我们道路的优越罢了。
entries.en: They simply could not bear the superiority of our ways.

entries.zh: 幸好，[dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对此坦然相对，愿意为盟友伙伴的和谐关系所带来的好处而妥协。
entries.en: Fortunately, the [dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took this in good grace, recognizing the need for compromise in the interest of a more harmonious relationship with their alliance partners.

entries.zh: 我们能靠言语说服别人。
entries.en: Through our words shall we persuade.

entries.en: Our membership in the federation is allowing militarist values to become increasingly widespread in our nation.

entries.en: Our membership in the federation is allowing egalitarianism to become increasingly widespread in our nation.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇是一种独特的太空生物，我们必须对其进行保护，使之免遭伤害。
entries.en: The Tiyanki are a unique form of spacefaring life, and they must be protected from those who would do them harm.

entries.zh: 任何击杀§Y缇扬奇§!的帝国会被视为§R违反星系法§!。
entries.en: Any empire that kills a §YTiyanki§! will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 星海共同体不该决定其成员国如何对待缇扬奇。
entries.en: It is not for the Galactic Community to decide how its members deal with the Tiyanki.

entries.zh: 这些漫游的缇扬奇不只惹人厌烦，还实际危害了航行安全。绝不能容忍在星系中愈发繁忙的航道上有这种难以预测的生物存在。
entries.en: The roving Tiyanki are not only a nuisance, but also a navigational hazard. The presence of these unpredictable creatures cannot be tolerated in the galaxy's increasingly busy spacelanes.

entries.zh: 任何境内有§Y缇扬奇§!的帝国均处于§R违反星系法§!状态，直至这些生物被消灭或是自动离开为止。
entries.en: Any empire with §YTiyanki§! inside their borders are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the creatures are destroyed or leave of their own accord.

entries.zh: 星海共同体无权迫使其成员国对缇扬奇格杀勿论。
entries.en: The Galactic Community has no place forcing its members to destroy the Tiyanki on sight.

entries.zh: 当星海共同体在很大程度上达成一致时，在整个会议期间继续唇枪舌剑简直就是浪费时间。如果我们达成共识，那我们就应该尽早停止争论，继续讨论其他事宜。
entries.en: When the Galactic Community is largely in agreement, it seems like a waste to continue debate for the full duration of the session. If we reach a consensus, we should end debate early and move on to other matters.

entries.zh: 如果连续180天中，绝大多数（75%或以上）议员赞成或反对议案，参议院会议将提前结束。
entries.en: Senate sessions will end early if there is a supermajority of 75% in favor or against the resolution for 180 consecutive days.

entries.zh: 无论出于什么原因，压缩辩论时间都令人不齿。我们的声音必须为人们听到！
entries.en: Cutting debate short for any reason is detestable. Our voices must be heard!

entries.zh: 利用泛星系贸易市场交易有情感的有机体简直可恶至极。我们应该禁止这种行为。
entries.en: The use of the Galactic Market to trade in sentient organics is abominable. We should ban this practice.

entries.zh: 无法继续在奴隶市场上出售感性有机体。
entries.en: Sentient organics can no longer be sold on the Slave Market.

entries.zh: 经济指标证明，我们先前对有机体奴隶贸易的限制显然大错特错。我们应当废除禁令，看自由市场如何化腐朽为神奇。
entries.en: Economic indicators prove that our earlier restrictions on the organic slave trade were clearly in error. We should repeal the ban and let the free market do its magic.

entries.zh: 可再次在奴隶市场上出售感性有机体。
entries.en: Sentient organics can once again be sold on the Slave Market.

entries.zh: 禁止交易有情感的奴隶
遗憾的是，我们先前的议案有漏洞，导致有人买卖有情感的机械体或有机体。我们应该亡羊补牢，禁止在泛星系贸易市场上交易任何感性生命体。
entries.en: It is regrettable that our previous resolution left a loophole for the sale of sentient mechanical organisms. We should rectify this mistake and ban the trade of all sentients on the Galactic Market.

entries.zh: 无法继续在奴隶市场上出售感性生命体。
entries.en: Sentient beings of any kind can no longer be sold on the Slave Market.

entries.zh: 允许交易有情感的机械奴隶
创造者应该有权随意处置其所有物，包括能模仿情感的物体。我们应该补偏救弊，废除所谓“有情感的”机器的交易禁令。
entries.en: Creators should have the right to do what they wish with their property. This includes objects that imitate sentience. We should repeal the misguided ban on the sale of these so-called 'sentient' machines.

entries.zh: 可再次在奴隶市场上出售有情感的奴隶。
entries.en: Sentient mechanical beings can once again be sold on the Slave Market.

entries.zh: 我们很怀疑当前领袖能否为泛星系贸易市场尽心尽力，因此，应当发起新一轮竞争，来决定市场的领袖。
entries.en: We question whether the Galactic Market is best served by its current leader. We should initiate a new competition to determine who should lead it.

entries.zh: 再次开始泛星系贸易市场领导权竞争。
entries.en: Begins the Galactic Market leadership competition again.

entries.zh: 泛星系贸易市场最近才刚迁移。
entries.en: The Galactic Market has been relocated too recently.

entries.zh: 我们之中地位最低的仍是我们的一员，我们应该携手并肩，在他们需要的时候伸出援手。
entries.en: The lowest among us is still one of us, and we should come together to assist them in their time of need.

entries.zh: 失业劳工的不满度惩罚减少§G10%§!。
entries.en: Unemployed workers have their unhappiness penalty reduced by §G10%§!.

entries.zh: 我们可以容忍没有灵魂的机械存在，但前提是我们能从中获益。我们应该对他们的生产征税，并利用所得行大义之事。
entries.en: We can tolerate the existence of soulless machines if some good can come from doing so. We should tax their production and use the proceeds for more righteous causes.

entries.zh: 人造产物绝不能凌驾于活人的生计之上。
entries.en: Artificial constructs should never take priority over the livelihoods of actual people.

entries.zh: 相较于失业机械人口，失业有机人口享有工作优先权。
entries.en: Unemployed organic pops gain priority for jobs over robotic pops.

entries.zh: 我们可以毫不在乎拟合智能的嗡嗡声，反正他们也不像有感情的样子。
entries.en: We can freely dismiss the ranting of simulated intelligences. It's not like they have feelings anyway.

entries.zh: 机械帝国和经历过合成进化的机械体的£diplo_weight£§Y$diplomatic_weight$§!减少§R-25%§!。\n\n§Y$SYNTHETIC_EVOLUTION_PROJECT$§!特殊项目现已§R禁用§!。
entries.en: Machine Empires and those that have undergone Synthetic Evolution have their £diplo_weight£ §Y$diplomatic_weight$§! reduced by §R-25%§!.\n\nThe §Y$SYNTHETIC_EVOLUTION_PROJECT$§! special project is §Rbanned§!.

entries.zh: 机械体是工具，必须更好地服务于人。我们应该颁布法律，确保这些没有灵魂的人口永远臣服于其形而上的既定主人。
entries.en: Machines are tools and must serve their betters. We should enact legislation to ensure that the spiritually bereft are forever in servitude to their metaphysically endowed superiors.

entries.zh: §Y$ai_full_rights_name$§!$policy_artificial_intelligence_policy$政策现已§R禁用§!。\n\n没有§Y$personality_servitors$§!的§Y$auth_machine_intelligence$§!帝国会被认为§R违反星系法§!，但是会有机会接纳这条国民理念。
entries.en: The §Y$ai_full_rights_name$§! $policy_artificial_intelligence_policy$ policy is §Rbanned§!.\n\n§Y$auth_machine_intelligence$§! empires that are not §Y$personality_servitors$§! are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!, but will be given the option to embrace the civic.

entries.zh: 这些令人厌恶的歧视性议案每存在一天都会让星海共同体蒙羞。人造生命也是生命。
entries.en: The Galactic Community embarrasses itself each day these repugnant discriminatory resolutions stand. Artificial life is still life.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_divinity_tithe_on_the_soulless$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_divinity_comfort_the_fallen$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_divinity_right_to_work$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_divinity_tithe_on_the_soulless$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_divinity_silence_the_soulless$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_divinity_right_to_work$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_divinity_a_defined_purpose$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_divinity_silence_the_soulless$§! as galactic law.\n\n

entries.zh: 星海共同体已通过§Y$resolution_divinity_a_defined_purpose$§!议案，禁用§Y$ai_full_rights_name$§!$policy_artificial_intelligence_policy$政策和非§Y失控机仆§!机械智能。\n\n我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
entries.en: The Galactic Community has passed the §Y$resolution_divinity_a_defined_purpose$§! resolution, which bans the §Y$ai_full_rights_name$§! $policy_artificial_intelligence_policy$ policy and non-§YRogue Servitor§! Machine Intelligences.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

entries.zh: 我们的帝国将用§Y$civic_machine_servitor$§!代替一条国民理念。\n\n首都中将添加一个有机人口。
entries.en: Our empire will replace one of our civics with §Y$civic_machine_servitor$§!.\n\nOne organic pop will be added to our capital.

entries.zh: 近期在星海共同体中的成功提升了我们的外交影响力。
entries.en: Our recent successes in the Galactic Community increase our diplomatic clout.

entries.zh: 近期在星海共同体中的失败降低了我们的外交影响力。
entries.en: Our recent failures in the Galactic Community reduce our diplomatic clout.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽。任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。\n\n不幸的是，我国境内就有缇扬奇存在。直至它们被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止，[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!。
entries.en: The Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests. Any member of the Galactic Community with Tiyanki inside their borders are legally obliged to see to the immediate euthanization of the creatures.\n\nUnfortunately, there are Tiyanki present within our space. Until they are dealt with, or they leave our space of their own accord, the [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。\n\n[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
entries.en: A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders.\n\nThe [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Tiyanki have either departed our space or been exterminated.

entries.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
entries.en: This infestation must be dealt with.

entries.zh: 星海共同体的官员就我们最近在§H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§!星系击杀缇扬奇提出抗议，通知我们我国的行为违反了缇扬奇保护法。结果是，[Root.GetName]将在接下来10年内被视为§R违反星系法§!。\n\n我们从缇扬奇尸体上提取的资源被收缴了，而且他们还对我国处以罚金。
entries.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have protested our recent killing of Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§! system, informing us that our actions have violated the Tiyanki Conservation Act. As a consequence, the [Root.GetName] is to be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! for the next ten years.\n\nThe resources we extracted from the dead Tiyanki have been confiscated, and we have been issued a fine.

entries.zh: 星海共同体的官员注意到[Root.GetName]境内有缇扬奇存在。由于缇扬奇害兽管制议案已经生效，这使得我国处于§R违反星系法§!状态，直至这些生物被消灭或是自行主动离开为止。
entries.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have observed the presence of Tiyanki within the borders of the [Root.GetName]. With the Tiyanki Pest Control resolution having been enacted, this leaves us in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the creatures are euthanized or leave our space of their own accord.

entries.zh: 尽管外表平平无奇，但与其他所有种群一样，太空变形虫也有在星系中畅游的权利。我们必须将其视为值得珍视的一种生命形态，而非可以随意捕杀的害虫。
entries.en: Despite their unseeming looks, the Space Amoebas have as much right to roam the galaxy as any species. They must be treated as a form of life worth cherishing, not as vermin to be hunted down.

entries.zh: 任何不同意与§Y太空变形虫§!和平共处的帝国都将被视作§R违反星系法§!。
entries.en: Any empire that does not agree to peacefully coexist with §YSpace Amoebas§! will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 太空变形虫是害虫，必须将其尽数消灭。
entries.en: Space Amoebas are a pest and must be eradicated.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_amoeba_conservation_act$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_tiyanki_conservation_act$§! as galactic law.\n\n

entries.zh: 星海共同体已通过§Y$resolution_amoeba_conservation_act$§!议案，要求帝国与§Y太空变形虫§!和平共处。\n\n我们的帝国目前不符合此议案的规定，要遵守此议案，更改相关政策吗？
entries.en: The Galactic Community has passed the §Y$resolution_amoeba_conservation_act$§! resolution, mandating that empires peacefully coexist with §YSpace Amoebas§!.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

entries.zh: 太空变形虫是害虫，必须将其尽数消灭！
entries.en: Space Amoebas are a pest and must be eradicated!
The [Root.GetName] will be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!

entries.zh: 缇扬奇已被逼至灭绝边缘
这些法律规定了我们的联邦发起战争的方式。我们的选择对所有成员都有约束力。
entries.en: These Laws dictate how our federation can go to war. Our choice will be binding for all members.

entries.zh: 星海共同体的特使们撰写了一封措辞强烈的文章，声称[Root.GetName]违反了星系法，并警告我们不遵守星系法可能带来的严重后果。\n\n我们是否要改变自己的政策，以迎合这一要求？
entries.en: Envoys from the Galactic Community have compiled a list of articles that the [Root.GetName] are in violation of, and warn of possible consequences should we not make ourselves in alignment with Galactic Law.\n\nShould we change our policies and accede to their demands?

entries.zh: 我们应该和星系法保持一致。
entries.en: Bring us into compliance with Galactic Law.

entries.zh: 我们的思潮允许我们服从星系法。
entries.en: Our ethics make it possible for us to enter compliance.

entries.zh: 我们的国民理念允许我们服从星系法。
entries.en: Our civics make it possible for us to enter compliance.

entries.zh: 我们的飞升天赋允许我们服从星系法。
entries.en: Our ascension perks make it possible for us to enter compliance.

entries.zh: 我们的科技允许我们服从星系法。
entries.en: We have the technology necessary for us to enter compliance.

entries.zh: 我们的起源允许我们服从。
entries.en: Our origin makes it possible for us to comply.

entries.zh: 我们将坚持己见，决不妥协。
entries.en: We will not change our ways.

entries.zh: 否决它，以及今后的任何回应。
entries.en: Dispose of it and any future correspondence.

entries.zh: 我们不会再看到星海共同体发来的类似要求。
entries.en: We will no longer see these requests from the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 这一行为会§R损害§!同星海共同体其他成员的关系。
entries.en: This will §Rharm relations§! with other Galactic Community members.

entries.zh: §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!中的最后一只缇扬奇已被§H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!击杀。由于它们的古老繁殖地已被净化，缇扬奇再也不能继续繁殖了，这是星系历史上的第一次。
entries.en: The last of the Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system have been exterminated by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

entries.zh: 它们走向最终灭绝似乎无可避免。
entries.en: Their path to eventual extinction seems unavoidable now.

entries.zh: 由于[tiyanki_system.GetName]外的全部已知缇扬奇已被捕杀，今天就标志着缇扬奇物种的终结。虽然缇扬奇曾在星系中叱咤了千百万年，但它们现在已经灭绝了。
entries.en: With all known Tiyanki outside of [tiyanki_system.GetName] having already been hunted down, today marks the end of their species. After having roamed the galaxy for hundreds of millions of years, the Tiyanki are now extinct.

entries.zh: 有传闻称尚有一只古老的缇扬奇族母逍遥在外。不论是否为真，从今天起，缇扬奇作为一个物种只能被看作已经灭绝。
entries.en: There are rumored sightings of an ancient Tiyanki Matriarch that yet remains at large. Whether true or not, after today the Tiyanki - as a species - can only be considered extinct.

entries.zh: §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!主序星旁，四颗于低轨道环绕的气态巨行星被笼罩在等离子场中。充能的等离子场深入气态巨行星大气内部，这种独特的环境是许多太空生物繁殖的温床。
entries.en: Four gas giants enshrouded by a vast plasma field share a close orbit around the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system's primary. The charged plasma field extends well into the atmospheres of these gas giants, and this unique environment serves as a breeding ground for a large number of spacefaring organisms.

entries.zh: 这些生物大都微乎其微，但有一个显著的例外——巨型§H缇扬奇§!。这个恒星系一定就是它们起初进化了千百万年的地方，随后它们开始在整个星系中漫游。由于这个恒星系的等离子场性质极为罕见，这里很可能是星系中缇扬奇唯一的繁殖地。
entries.en: These organisms are all miniscule, with one notable exception - the massive §HTiyanki§!. This system must be where they originally evolved hundreds of millions of years ago, before they ranged deeper into the galaxy. Given the extremely rare properties of the system's plasma field, this is likely the only place in the galaxy where the Tiyanki can reproduce.

entries.zh: 这些生物大都微乎其微，但有一个显著的例外——一种我们先前从未见过的大型生物。尽管我们对它们掌握的数据并不多，但是它们似乎会非常频繁地在星系中游荡。如果我们对它们能够了解更多，我们或许能够发觉是什么吸引着它们前来这个恒星系，以及这一现象是否能够给我们带来益处。
entries.en: These organisms are all miniscule, with one notable exception - massive creatures unlike anything we have ever seen. Although we possess little data on them, they seem to frequently range deep into the galaxy. If we learn more about them we might figure out what attracts them to this system, and if it can be beneficial to us in any way.

entries.zh: 最后一只已知缇扬奇已经在§H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§!星系中被§H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§!捕杀。这些太空生物出现的时间比所有现存帝国更早，据信已经在星系中叱咤了千百万年。今天就是它们故事的终结。
entries.en: The last known Tiyanki was recently hunted down and killed by the §H[tiyanki_killer.GetName]§! in the §H[tiyanki_system.GetName]§! system. These spacefaring life forms, who were far older than any currently existing empire, are believed to have roamed the galaxy for hundreds of millions of years. Today marks the end of their storied history.

entries.zh: 很久很久以前，即使在我们国家还如日中天的时候，缇扬奇已经被视作古老的生物了……现在我听说一批[Root.GetSpeciesName]舰船最近屠杀了这些手无寸铁的生物，使得缇扬奇彻底灭绝。\n\n你们卑微的[Root.GetSpeciesName]大脑能理解自己干的事情吗？你们对自己无情的举动从星系中窃取走的东西有最起码的理解吗？
entries.en: Even when our empire was at the height of its power, eons ago, the Tiyanki were considered ancient, and now... now I am told that a bunch of [Root.GetSpeciesName] WHELPS recently slew the last of the defenseless creatures, rendering them extinct.\n\nCan your feeble [Root.GetSpeciesName] brains comprehend what you have done? Do you have even the slightest notion of what your callous actions have stolen from this galaxy?
We... we didn't mean for this to happen.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇的时代结束了，你们也一样。
entries.en: Like you, their time had passed.

entries.zh: 整个星系应该感谢我们。
我们在§H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§!星系中成功捕杀了一些野生缇扬奇。我方舰队用激光切割以从巨型缇扬奇的尸体内提取矿物和资源。
entries.en: We have successfully hunted down and killed some wild Tiyanki in the §H[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]§! system. Our fleet has used laser cutters to extract materials and resources from the massive Tiyanki remains.

entries.zh: 星海共同体的官员收到了我们最近就缇扬奇族母取得胜利的消息。他们告诉我方，消灭这只野兽明显违反了缇扬奇保护法，就算缇扬奇族母是敌对生物也一样。\n\n[Root.GetName]将在接下来十年内被视为§R违反星系法§!。此外，我们收到了一份巨额的罚单，理由是我们消灭了“一种独特的，整个星系中再也见不到的缇扬奇生命形式”。
entries.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have received word of our recent victory against the Tiyanki Matriarch. They have informed us that our destruction of the beast was a clear violation of the Tiyanki Conservation Act, regardless of the Matriarch's hostile nature.\n\nThe [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! for the next ten years. Additionally, we have been issued with a hefty fine for our killing of "a unique Tiyanki life form whose like the galaxy shall never see again."
It had to be put down.

entries.zh: 但是……是它攻击我们的啊！
你们对缇扬奇的野蛮攻击是不可饶恕的罪行。总有一天，清算会到来的。
entries.en: Your savage attacks on the Tiyanki are unforgivable crimes. One day, there shall be a reckoning.

entries.zh: 你们肆意残杀手无寸铁的缇扬奇，这不会被忽略的。
entries.en: Your wanton murder of defenseless Tiyanki has not gone unnoticed.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇从来算不上威胁……你们是出于什么而攻击缇扬奇的呢？
entries.en: The Tiyanki have never been a threat... what could possibly have compelled you to attack them?

entries.zh: 在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!恒星系发现的一颗完全被缇扬奇尸体覆盖了的行星。想研究这一怪异的埋葬地，我们必须先解决它的守墓人。
entries.en: A planet entirely covered in the bodies of dead Tiyanki has been found in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system. In order to study this unusual burial ground, we must first deal with its gravekeepers.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇以气体为食。建造一座气体散播站，我们就能引走那些守在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!恒星系的缇扬奇，并且接近他们的坟场。
entries.en: Tiyanki feed on gas. By building a gas diffuser station, we may lure out the Tiyanki stationed in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system and gain access to their burial ground.

entries.zh: 这座空间站释放富有营养的气体云，把守墓缇扬奇勾引离开值守。
entries.en: The station releases clouds of nourishing gas, diverting the Tiyanki gravekeepers from their duties.

entries.zh: 肃清守在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!的缇扬奇以接近他们的坟场。
entries.en: Eliminate the Tiyanki stationed in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! to gain access to their burial ground.

entries.zh: 生活在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!星系的缇扬奇的行为与该物种的已知行为模式并不一致。缇扬奇通常是迁徙性的，而这群缇扬奇却紧紧守在一颗满是他们同类尸体的行星周围。\n\n它们遮天蔽日的触手阻碍了对这个坟地的研究，除非我们将它们引走或者处置掉，否则进一步的调查难以进行。
entries.en: The actions of the Tiyanki inhabiting the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system do not match known behavior patterns for their species. While Tiyanki are usually nomadic, these herds remain stationed around a planet entirely covered in the carcasses of their own dead.\n\nAttempts to study the burial ground have been hindered by the net of tentacles the Tiyanki have wrapped around the planet, making further research impossible - unless we are willing to displace or dispose of the gravekeepers.

entries.zh: 缇扬奇就还挺弱的。宰了它们。
entries.en: Tiyanki make easy prey. Eliminate them.

entries.zh: 在不伤害他们的前提下引走吧。
entries.en: Displace the gravekeepers without harming them.

entries.zh: 在肃清停留在[FromFrom.System.GetName]的缇扬奇之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以安全地接近墓地，进一步开展研究。
entries.en: Having eliminated the Tiyanki stationed in [FromFrom.System.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] can now safely approach the burial ground to conduct their research.

entries.zh: 我们已经在§H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§!星系完成了缇扬奇诱饵的建设。受到散播装置释放的营养性气体的误导，守墓的兽群被诱惑离开了他们的驻地，允许我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]悄悄溜过它们的触手，在不引起注意的情况下接近墓地。
entries.en: The construction of the Tiyanki lure in the §H[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]§! system has been completed. Beguiled by the nourishing gases released by the diffuser, the gravekeepers are lured away from their post, allowing our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] to slip through their tentacles and approach the burial ground unnoticed.

entries.zh: 一大群§H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§!聚集在一个行星的周边，上面遍布某种外星生命体的尸体。\n\n由于我们对于这些外星实体没有任何信息，我们只能对它们的行为进行猜测。
entries.en: A large number of §H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§! are clustered around a planet covered in the carcasses of some alien life-form.\n\nHaving no information on those alien entities, we can only speculate on their behavior.

entries.zh: 同§H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§!建立第一次接触以了解更多信息。
entries.en: Establish first contact with the §H[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]§! to learn more.

entries.zh: 从小行星带取回的岩石样本包含大量的生物组织，这让人始料未及。
entries.en: Rock samples retrieved from the asteroid belt unexpectedly contain a large amount of biological tissue.

entries.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]一开始以为这是小行星，结果发现这其实是冰冻的、被压实的缇扬奇尸体，在轨道上历经几十年之后，成为一堆不成形状的块状物。整个小行星环，实际上，是一片露天墓地。其中的一部分尸体是最近刚刚到达并开始腐坏的，而剩下的已历经千年岁月，甚至比我们的帝国还要久远。
entries.en: What our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] first mistook for asteroids have been revealed to be frozen, battered Tiyanki corpses reduced to shapeless lumps after decades in orbit. The entire asteroid ring is, in fact, just an open burial ground. Some of the bodies we acquired are recently deceased, while others predate our empire by thousand of years.

entries.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]一开始以为这是小行星，结果发现这其实是冰冻的、被压实的外星动物尸体，其体型基本和在这个恒星系游荡的外星生命体一致。整个小行星环，实际上，是一片露天墓地。其中的一部分尸体是最近刚刚到达并开始腐坏的，而剩下的已历经千年岁月，甚至比我们的帝国还要久远。
entries.en: What our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] first mistook for asteroids have been revealed to be frozen, battered corpses of alien fauna, roughly matching the shape of the aliens seen roaming the system. The entire asteroid ring is, in fact, just an open burial ground. Some of the bodies we acquired are recently deceased, while others predate our empire by thousand of years.

entries.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
entries.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

entries.zh: 我们实在是很难说[From.Planet.GetName]到底算不算作一个行星：初步钻探发现的是一层又一层的生物组织。据估计，总共需要2,435,463只缇扬奇尸体才能产生此等规模的行星质量（误差范围5.3%）。即使我们假设地核是一块岩石，尸体只是堆叠在上面，涉及到的样本数量依然是无比庞大的。\n\n是某人或者某种事物将缇扬奇带到这里让它们死去，还是说它们只是顺其自然地来到这里度过最后的时光，然后死去？
entries.en: It's hard to determine if [From.Planet.GetName] is even a planet: preliminary drilling has only revealed strata upon strata of biological tissue. According to estimations, it would take 2,435,463 Tiyanki bodies to produce a planetary mass of this size (with a margin of error equal to 5.3%). Even assuming the existence of a rocky core upon which the corpses are layered, the number of specimens involved is still significant.\n\nDid someone or something bring the Tiyanki here to die, or are they naturally drawn to this place as their final hour draws near?

entries.zh: $ancrel.14100.desc$最重要的是：为什么我们的死灵法师不能复活它们？为什么这堆死去的肉体拒绝我们，就好像已经有其他存在在控制它们一样？
entries.en: $ancrel.14100.desc$ Most crucially: why are our Necromancers unable to revive them? Why does this dead flesh reject us, as if already controlled by another entity?

entries.zh:
遍布[From.Planet.GetName]地表的死亡缇扬奇的那种不寻常……的活动，似乎是它们再生能力的一种副作用：即使技术上已经判定为死亡，它们的尸体仍旧在不断地重组再生。这个恒星系拥有着非比寻常般丰富的营养物质，尤其是缇扬奇游荡的那个气态巨行星。或许这解释了为什么我们之前从未观察到这样的行为。

然而，这个发现并没有解释为什么这些死去的生物像是在被某种单一思维控制一样蠕动，不断地伸出触手，吞食新近降落到这个行星上的尸体。

我们希望进一步的挖掘能够揭示这个地方，或这个生命……的内在运作规律，带给我们新的见解。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]还在就术语和分类问题无法达成一致。
entries.en:
The unusual... liveliness of the dead Tiyanki covering the surface of [From.Planet.GetName] seems to be a byproduct of their regenerative capabilities: even if technically dead, the bodies are still reassembling themselves. This system is unusually rich in nourishing substances typically found in the gas giants where Tiyanki graze. Perhaps that explains why this behavior hasn't been observed before.

This discovery does not explain why the dead seem to move as if controlled by a single mind, extending their tentacles to encroach upon the new carcasses falling on the planet.

Further excavations will hopefully reveal new insights on the inner workings of this... place. Or being. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are still divided on the exact nomenclature.

entries.zh: 我们的挖掘队发掘到了一个复杂的隧道网络，从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表一直延伸到地下深处。化学分析确认迷宫的墙体是由压实的缇扬奇组织构成，尽管其年代甚至超过了我们的帝国，但肉质还散发着温热，甚至几乎没有腐败。看上去就像是这些尸体自己聚合到了一起，重构其形态建立了这个地方……但是为什么？
entries.en: Our excavations unearthed a complex network of tunnels extending under the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Chemical analysis confirms the walls are entirely composed of highly compressed Tiyanki tissue, the flesh still warm and hardly decomposed despite rivaling the age of our empire. It's as if the corpses were fused together, reshaped and modified to form this place... But why?

entries.zh: 在对[From.Planet.GetName]的地下隧道网络进行测绘的时候，我们[Owner.GetScientistPlural]突然意识到，这个隧道网络同一只缇扬奇的血管系统极其相似——但是其规模达到了行星级别。\n\n那些搏动的墙壁散发着轻微的温暖，随着探险队逐渐接近行星的核心，墙壁的温度也在慢慢提升——在核心处，我们的扫描仪捕捉到了一个微弱的生命信号。
entries.en: After mapping the extensive underground network of [From.Planet.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] realized the tunnels closely match the structure of the Tiyanki vascular system - but on a planetary scale.\n\nThe pulsating walls emanate a soft warmth, the temperature slowly increasing as the expedition approached the planet core - where our scanners have picked up a faint life signal.

entries.zh: 在对[From.Planet.GetName]的地下隧道网络进行测绘的时候，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]突然意识到，这个隧道网络同一只缇扬奇的血管系统极其相似——但是其规模跟我们之前遇到的那只在星辰间游荡的缇扬奇族母差不多。\n\n那些搏动的墙壁散发着轻微的温暖，随着探险队逐渐接近行星的核心，墙壁的温度也在慢慢提升——在核心处，我们的扫描仪捕捉到了一个微弱的生命信号。
entries.en: After mapping the extensive underground network of [From.Planet.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] realized the tunnels closely match the structure of the Tiyanki vascular system - but on a scale comparable to that of the Tiyanki Matriarch we encountered while roaming the stars.\n\nThe pulsating walls emanate a soft warmth, the temperature slowly increasing as the expedition approached the planet core - where our scanners have picked up a faint life signal.

entries.zh: 在一个庞大的地下穴室中，一只缇扬奇竖立地站着，钟型的脑袋微微地摇晃着，它细线一样的触手舒展开来，连接着穴室的外墙。看上去它成为了某种控制单元，不断操纵、指引着这个行星级别墓地的生长。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]没法断定什么种类的生物会从如此恐怖的过程中诞生，但是当它苏醒的时候，有一件事是很明确的：它会成为远比普通的缇扬奇要大得多，也恐怖得多的存在。
entries.en: In a vast underground chamber, a Tiyanki stands upright, bell-shaped head swaying lightly, its wiry tentacles spread across the floor to connect with the outer walls of the chamber. It appears to be some sort of command unit, controlling and directing the growth of this planet-sized graveyard.\n\nOur [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are unable to determine what kind of creature will arise from this grim process, and when it will awaken, but one thing is for sure: it will be something far, far more vast and terrible than an ordinary Tiyanki.

entries.zh: 在一个庞大的地下穴室中，一只缇扬奇竖立地站着，钟型的脑袋微微地摇晃着，它细线一样的触手舒展开来，连接着穴室的外墙。看上去它成为了某种控制单元，不断操纵、指引着这个行星级别墓地的生长。\n\n我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]没法断定这个过程什么时候会完成，但是相信一旦这只生物苏醒，它会成为远比普通的缇扬奇要大得多，也恐怖得多的存在：这只生物值得我们视作一只新的§H缇扬奇族母§!。
entries.en: In a vast underground chamber, a Tiyanki stands upright, bell-shaped head swaying lightly, its wiry tentacles spread across the floor to connect with the outer walls of the chamber. It appears to be some sort of command unit, controlling and directing the growth of this planet-sized graveyard.\n\nOur [Owner.GetScientistPlural] don't know when the process will be concluded, but believe once the creature awakens, it will be something far, far more vast and terrible than an ordinary Tiyanki: something worthy of being called a new §HTiyanki Matriarch§!.

entries.zh: 在不伤害它的前提下监视其生长。
entries.en: Monitor its growth without harming it.

entries.zh: 让这个神圣的生命体在和平中成长吧。
entries.en: Let this sacred life-form growth in peace.

entries.zh: 策展人肯定愿意为这个标本付个好价钱。
entries.en: The Curators will pay a good price for this specimen.

entries.zh: 在一个庞大的地下穴室中，一只缇扬奇竖立地站着，钟型的脑袋微微地摇晃着，它细线一样的触手舒展开来，连接着穴室的外墙。看上去它成为了某种控制单元，不断操纵、指引着这个行星级别墓地的生长。但是这个生物现在已经死了，被我们用来前往这个地方的挖掘设备毁灭了。核心周边的外壳变得苍白而易碎，整个地方经历了第二次死亡。
entries.en: In a vast underground chamber, a Tiyanki stands upright, bell swaying lightly, its wiry tentacles spread on the floor to connect with the outer walls of the chamber. It appeared to be some sort of control unit, controlling and directing the growth of the grave mound. But the creature is now dead, destroyed by the mining equipment we used to get access to this same place. The shells around the core are pallid and brittle; soon, this whole place will die a second death.

entries.zh:
我们探险队的一名成员在探索隧道的时候突然消失了。搜寻小队花了好几天时间试图定位[Owner.GetScientist]，结果发现这人被一堵墙给包裹住，身体被触手死死地缠住。

把[Owner.GetScientist]解救出来花费了不少时间和精力。[Owner.GetScientist]并不只是被简单地缠住了：这堵墙正试图在分子层面将[Owner.GetScientist]融合，使其成为墙体表面的一部分。

现在[Owner.GetScientist]的状态稳定了下来，但此人拒绝离开我们的科研船——即使是在那里，也在用极度怀疑的状态死死地盯着墙壁，生怕还会有下一次袭击。
entries.en:
A member of our expedition team disappeared while exploring a tunnel. The retrieval squad spent days trying to locate the [Owner.GetScientist], only to find them partly encased in a wall, body tightly wrapped in tentacles.

Freeing the [Owner.GetScientist] took considerable time and effort. The [Owner.GetScientist] was not simply tied: the wall was trying to fuse with the [Owner.GetScientist] at a molecular level, turning them into a part of the surface.

The [Owner.GetScientist] is now in stable condition, but refuses to leave our science ship - and even there, they keep watching the walls with extreme suspicion as though fearing another attack.

entries.zh: 获取生物质的一种有趣途径。
entries.en: An intriguing way to acquire biomatter.

entries.zh: 第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但是，有一种生命体在这种环境下顽强地繁衍生息，那就是太空变形虫。它们放弃了原本相当孤独的生活方式，成群结队地聚在一起，在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，这似乎是精心安排的繁殖仪式。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, there is one life form that appears to thrive in this environment - the space amoeba. Giving up their otherwise fairly solitary lifestyle, they have congregated in great numbers, flitting in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.

entries.zh: $galactic_features.500.desc.base$\n\n目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向[Root.GetName]，公然对其施加威胁。
entries.en: $galactic_features.500.desc.base$\n\nIt is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned their flagella towards the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

entries.zh: $galactic_features.500.desc.base$\n\n目前还不清楚是什么原因导致变形虫偏爱这种不宜居的星系。幸运的是，它们似乎乐意与我们共享栖息地，没有对[Root.GetName]采取任何有敌意的措施。
entries.en: $galactic_features.500.desc.base$\n\nIt is unclear what could possibly have caused the amoebas to favor this inhospitable system. Fortunately, however, they appear content to share it with us, and have made no hostile moves toward the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 第一眼看过去，[From.GetName]星系就显示出强烈的敌意：所有行星都不适宜居住，不是被星系中的三个太阳轮番炙烤，就是有强烈的太阳风暴肆虐。但尽管如此，这里似乎居住着大量前所未知的大型太空有机体。它们在酷热的内部星系和远方的气态巨行星之间飞来飞去，似乎在进行精心安排的繁殖仪式。\n\n目前还不清楚此星系对这些生物有什么吸引力。不管怎样，它们似乎意图保护自己的栖息地，并已将矛头指向我们，公然以一种威胁的姿态接近[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] system gives off a strongly hostile impression on first sight: none of its planets are remotely habitable, either scorched by the searing heat of the system's three suns or stripped of life by powerful solar storms. However, despite all this, it seems to be inhabited in large numbers by a previously unknown large spaceborne organism, groups of which flit in and out between the blisteringly hot inner system and the large gas giant further out in what appears to be an elaborate breeding ritual.\n\nIt is unclear what attraction this system could possibly hold for these creatures. Regardless, they seem intent on protecting it, and have already turned towards us, approaching the [Root.GetName] in an overtly threatening manner.

entries.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的领地，出于天性，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们的哨站。
entries.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, entering our territory in the [FromFrom.GetName] system. As is the norm with these creatures, they seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts.

entries.zh: 一大群太空变形虫已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。现在可以观测到，它们数量惊人，正浩浩荡荡地穿越[FromFrom.GetName]星系。幸运的是，我们已经揭开了与这些巨型生物和平共处的奥秘，因此我们不必过度担忧它们的活动。
entries.en: A large group of Space Amoebas has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, and can now be seen crossing the [FromFrom.GetName] system in impressive numbers. Fortunately, we have uncovered the secret to peaceful coexistence with these majestic beings, so we need not be overly concerned at their movements..

entries.zh: 一大群太空有机体已脱离其在[amoeba_home_system.GetName]星系的种群，开始独自游荡在星系之中。这些生物进入了我们的领地，它们似乎无法容忍我们的存在，于是便开始攻击我们在[FromFrom.GetName]星系的哨站。
entries.en: A large group of spaceborne organisms has split off from those in the [amoeba_home_system.GetName] system and struck out to roam the galaxy on their own, bringing them into our own territory. They seem unable to tolerate our presence and have begun attacking our outposts in the [FromFrom.GetName] system.

entries.zh: 巨型亚空间扰动已在整个星系中出现！早期报告表明星系中50%的恒星系受到这一前所未有的现象影响，原因似乎是数千年来旧有及现存文明频繁超空间航行的副作用。\n\n科学家对星系级“宇宙风暴”会在5到10年内自行消散很有信心。在那之前，风暴将对所有受影响星系内的亚光速引擎，护盾生成器及传感器系统产生严重损害。
entries.en: Massive subspace disturbances have erupted in systems across the galaxy! Early reports indicate that nearly 50% of the systems in the galaxy have been affected by this unprecedented phenomenon, which appears to be a byproduct of thousands of years of heavy hyperspace travel by civilizations both past and present.\n\nScientists are confident that this galactic "space storm" will dissipate by itself within a period of 5 to 10 years. Until that happens, the storm will play havoc with sublight engines, shield generators, and sensor systems in those star systems affected by it.

entries.zh: 影响了星系中诸多区域的宇宙风暴来得快，去得也快。亚空间扰动显现的那些恒星系内的航运系统不再受到任何损害。\n\n尽管有人推测类似风暴会在数千年后最终使得超空间网络崩溃，至少现在太空航行似乎已经恢复正常了。
entries.en: As quickly as it appeared, the space storm that was affecting much of the galaxy has completely dissipated. Ship systems will no longer be impaired in those systems where subspace disturbances had manifested.\n\nAlthough some speculate that storms such as this could lead to the eventual collapse of the hyperspace network thousands of years in the future, for now space travel seems to have returned to normal.

entries.zh: $galactic_features.402.desc$\n\n星海共同体将风暴正式命名为§H“[storm_name.GetFirstName]”§!并发布了通用旅行建议。
entries.en: $galactic_features.402.desc$\n\nThe Galactic Community has officially named this storm §H"[storm_name.GetFirstName]"§! and issued a general travel advisory.

entries.zh: 影响了星系中诸多区域的§H宇宙风暴[storm_name.GetFirstName]§!来得快，去得也快。亚空间扰动显现的那些恒星系内的航运系统不再受到任何损害。\n\n尽管有人推测类似[storm_name.GetFirstName]的风暴会在数千年后最终使得超空间网络崩溃，至少现在太空航行似乎已经恢复正常了。
entries.en: As quickly as it appeared, §HSpace Storm [storm_name.GetFirstName]§! has completely dissipated. Ship systems will no longer be impaired in those systems where subspace disturbances had manifested.\n\nAlthough some speculate that storms such as [storm_name.GetFirstName] could lead to the eventual collapse of the hyperspace network thousands of years in the future, for now space travel seems to have returned to normal.

entries.zh:
我们在§H[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系内遭遇了某种极为强大的亚空间实体。它似乎没有敌意，对传统飞行器或许甚至没有完全察觉，但它的存在使得[From.From.From.GetName]整个恒星系中出现了强烈的亚空间扰动。

这些扰动位于实体自身周围，在它离开恒星系后应该也会消失。它对我们的致意没有回复，但这个实体一直在发射模式复杂，似乎是某种语言的快子流。如果我们的翻译软件正确的话，它一遍又一遍说的是：

§H“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”§!
entries.en:
An extremely powerful subspace entity of some kind has been encountered in the §H[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. It does not appear hostile and may not even be fully aware of conventional spacecraft, but its mere presence in [From.From.From.GetName] is causing massive subspace disturbances in the entire system.

These disturbances are localized around the entity itself and should disappear when it leaves the system. While it does not acknowledge hails, the entity is continuously emitting a complex pattern of tachyon pulses which appears to be a form of language. If our translation software is correct, it is saying, over and over:

§H"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds.§!"
This will interfere with ship systems.

entries.zh:
在与§H[vluur_system.GetName]§!星系中我方军队交战时，亚空间实体§H“弗雷尔”§!提高了其发送快子流的频率，但不停重复的信息与之前一样：

§H“弗雷尔在寻找。弗雷尔找到了。”§!

在受到致命一击的同时，这个实体自爆了，大爆炸使得整个恒星系中撒满了暗物质。
entries.en:
Throughout its battle with our forces in the §H[vluur_system.GetName]§! system, the subspace entity §H"VLUUR"§! increased the frequency at which it was emitting tachyon pulses, but the endlessly repeating message remained the same:

§H"VLUUR seeks. VLUUR finds."§!

When the final killing blow was delivered, the entity detonated in a massive explosion that showered the system in dark matter.

entries.zh: 收集一切可以收集的东西。
entries.en: We shall collect what we can.

entries.zh: 暗物质矿藏散落于[vluur_system.GetName]恒星系中的数个行星上。
entries.en: Dark Matter deposits are scattered to several worlds in the [vluur_system.GetName] system.

entries.zh:
[root.GetName]代表：$pirate.155.proclamation$

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就不会有人受到伤害。请放心，我们会将正式占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]生态居住繁殖计划中。我方对你方的贴心表示无比的感激。

$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$
entries.en:
Representatives of the [root.GetName]: $pirate.155.proclamation$

Sometimes these customs checks can be stressful. We understand. Co-operate, and no one need be harmed. And please, rest assured that every grain and ore we solemnly claim will be put to good use within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. We are grateful for your consideration.

$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$

entries.zh:
[root.GetName]的构造体代表：封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。从此以后，该区域的所有机械单位都将成为[thalassocracy_country.GetName]的臣民，为我们服务。反抗的舰队将遭到武力镇压。

我们理解此举可能会对你国造成物质上的极大不便。但我们保证，只要我们的$name_thalassocracy_agency$军官达到其指定配额，我们就会停止此举措。你一定对我们这样的指令系统面临的压力能够表示理解。

在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]的生态居住繁殖图景中，你方重新编程的无人机将承担崇高的使命。$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$
entries.en:
Representative construct of the [root.GetName]: a blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Any and all machine units in this region are henceforth subjects of the [thalassocracy_country.GetName]; they will be made to service us. Resisting fleets will be fired upon.

We appreciate that this operation may represent a material inconvenience to you. We assure you that it will conclude, once our $name_thalassocracy_agency$ officers meet their designated quotas. Surely you can understand the pressures of a directive like ours.

A worthy sense of purpose awaits your re-programmed drones within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. $pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$

entries.zh:
[root.GetName]实体代表：$pirate.155.proclamation$

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就能防止你们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]受伤，否则，它们可能会遇到麻烦。请放心，我们会将占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]生态居住繁殖计划中。希望你们能共同考虑此提议，我们感激不尽。

$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$
entries.en:
Representative entity of the [root.GetName]: $pirate.155.proclamation$

Sometimes these customs checks can be stressful. We understand. Co-operate, and no [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] need be harmed or otherwise inconvenienced. And please, rest assured that every grain and ore we claim will go to good homes within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. We are grateful for your collective consideration.

$pirate.155.thalassocracy_signoff$

entries.zh: 暂时封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。在此星系加工和运输的食物及矿物现在会被[thalassocracy_country.GetName]$name_thalassocracy_agency$军官查封。所有非商用飞船将遭到驱逐，若执意前行则会受到炮火攻击。这些条件将一直生效，直至我们完成$name_thalassocracy_agency_abbreviated$配额。
entries.en: a temporary blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Processing and transportation of food and minerals through this system are now subject to seizure by $name_thalassocracy_agency$ officers of the [thalassocracy_country.GetName]. All non-merchant vessels will be turned away, or else fired upon. These conditions shall remain in effect until our $name_thalassocracy_agency_abbreviated$ quotas can be met.

entries.zh: 亲手打造更加光明的未来！
一定要走到这一步吗，啊？
entries.en: Must it come to this, really?

entries.zh: 真是大胆的行动，[thalassocracy_species.GetAdj]。你们虽然蠢钝如猪，但确实胆大包天。
entries.en: A bold move, [thalassocracy_species.GetAdj]. Foolish, but bold.

entries.zh: 我国各处的多个研究站探测到了以[root.Capital.GetName]的恒星基地为中心，超空间中存在的轻微变形。这一效应在“真空”中表现为局部的类极光现象，居住在恒星基地上的人员将其描述为一种色彩鲜艳的气态卷须，包裹着整个空间站。\n\n此外，我们在[root.GetAllianceName]中的盟友报告称他们的首都星系出现了类似现象。总统[discloud_coordinator.ruler.GetRegnalName]已呼吁立即对此事开展合作调查。
entries.en: Various research stations across our empire have detected subtle distortions in hyperspace, centered upon the starbase at [root.Capital.GetName]. The effect presents in 'real space' as a localized aurora, which starbase inhabitants describe as brightly-colored, gaseous tendrils enveloping the station.\n\nFurthermore: our allies in the [root.GetAllianceName] report similar phenomena in their capital systems. President [discloud_coordinator.ruler.GetRegnalName] has called for an immediate and coordinated investigation into this matter.

entries.zh: 色彩鲜艳的卷须状云团聚集在我国首都星系周围。我们的盟友报告称在他们首都也出现了类似效应。是什么导致了这些现象？
entries.en: Brightly-colored tendrils of cloud have gathered around the starbase in our capital system. Our allies report similar effects at their capitals. What's causing these phenomena?

entries.zh: 色彩鲜艳的卷须状云团封闭了我们在[root.Capital.GetName]的恒星基地，以一种缺少规律——或许甚至是有生命——的方式从亚空间中来去。是什么导致了这种情况？\n\n这一项目是[root.GetAllianceName]成员国进行的更广泛的科学研究的一部分。
entries.en: Brightly-colored tendrils of cloud have latched onto our starbase at [root.Capital.GetName], phasing in and out of hyperspace in an erratic - or perhaps even organic - manner. What's causing this?\n\nThis project is part of a wider scientific effort being conducted by members of the [root.GetAllianceName].

entries.zh: [root.GetAllianceName]各成员国获得一个§H特殊项目§!，以对这些现象间存在的关联进行联合调查。
entries.en: Each member of the [root.GetAllianceName] will be tasked with a §HSpecial Project§! - a joint effort to find what links these phenomena.

entries.zh: 我们对[root.Capital.GetName]中极光状云团的调查解决了一些问题，但提出了更多疑问。这些形态各异的卷须状云团会在我们向盟友的研究队伍发出通讯光束后出现，但也只有这样才会出现。
entries.en: Our investigation of the aurora-like cloud at [root.Capital.GetName] raised more questions than answers. Distinct tendrils of cloud form whenever we beam communications to our allies' research teams - but only then.

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$每朵云都略带红色，边缘凹凸不平，移动方式躁动。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ Each is tinged with red, appearing jagged at the edges - and they move in an agitated manner.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$每朵云都是黄色，边缘模糊不清。它们缓缓移动，如同被微风吹拂一般。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ Each one appears yellow, with hazily-defined edges. The whisps move lethargically, as though caught in a gentle breeze.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$这些云看起来是生意盎然的绿色，这些蒸汽的移动似乎有目的性，以某种方式示意着什么。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ Appearing to us in vibrant green, these vapors' movements have been described as somehow beckoning and purposeful.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$这些蓝色隆起似乎有些害羞难觅，在被直接观察到时总是躲回超空间之中。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ These blue protruberances seem somehow elusive or shy, phasing back into hyperspace whenever they are observed directly.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$云朵上清晰可辨的紫色“附肢”缓缓移动，专门瞄着恒星基地外表的各种部件，仿佛在对其进行评估。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ Each vivid, purple 'appendage' of the cloud moves slowly and purposefully to point at various features on the exterior of the starbase, as though appraising it.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$这些朦胧的粉色蒸汽团据说很“顽皮”，会从偶然接近的舰船旁边快速逃开。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ These pink and hazy vapors have been described as 'playful', skittering away from any ships which happen to approach.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$它们存在的时间较长，其后留下似乎是灰色的烟迹。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ They remain present for extended periods, leaving behind trails of what appears to be gray smoke.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$这些体积很大的橙色弧状云团喜欢在我们恒星基地的下侧弯曲，使得恒星基地如同着火了一般。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ These sweeping, orange curves will tend to curl around the underside of our starbase, giving it the appearance of being on fire.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$它们深棕的色调通常并不透光；遮蔽了恒星基地上正常情况下能看到的灿烂星光。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ Their deep brown hues seem unusually opaque; they obscure much of the starscape one would normally see from within the starbase.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: $federations3.2010.intro$气体团内明晰的青色色调使其外表如同行星上的极光一般——不过它的色带会自发从曲线变幻成直角，如同要组成数码波一般。\n\n$federations3.2010.close$
entries.en: $federations3.2010.intro$ A vivid, cyan tint within the gas gives it the appearance of a planetary aurora - only its various bands will spontaneously switch from sweeping curves to right-angles, as though forming a digital wave.\n\n$federations3.2010.close$

entries.zh: 单靠我们自己无法从这些行为中分辨出进一步的含义——但在§Y全体成员国结果汇总后§!，[root.GetAllianceName]应该会有更多答案。\n\n初期理论猜测这些跨维度实体以某种方式与我们的超空间通讯频段产生了谐振。这次意外的引诱或许可以用来进一步利用这些实体进行研究，或者我们可以切换频率，希望这些云团会消散。
entries.en: On our own, we are unable to discern any further meaning from these behaviors - but the [root.GetAllianceName] expects to have more answers once §Yevery member's results are collated§!.\n\nEarly theories suggest these dimension-spanning entities somehow harmonize with our hyperspace communication bands. This accidental lure could be kept in place in order to further exploit the entity for study, or we could switch frequencies in the hopes of dispersing it.

entries.zh: 在对我们的研究结果进行比对后发现，这些在我们联邦成员国首都盘绕的、看似没有知觉的极光状云团事实上组成了一个单一的有生命实体。
entries.en: The results of our findings have been collated: it would seem that every instance of barely-sentient aurora cloud at our federation's capitals was, in fact, part of a single, living entity.

entries.zh:
$federations3.2015.intro$

研究者们能得出的结果如下：这个居住在超空间的实体因为事故漂移到了我们联邦的宇域，它被“钩在”我们最为繁忙（也就是为我们首都的恒星基地提供服务）的太空通讯中继器上。研究者一致同意这个气态实体之前正§H尝试重组自身§!，如果不是现在的状况，它处于碎片状态下是做不到这件事的。

在重组完成后，这朵云消失了，它回到了超空间中——但在此之前它到访了我们联盟中的许多研究站。在每个研究站，它多次准确地穿入穿出超空间，在旁观者看来如同舞蹈一般。云朵展示了它穿越超空间屏障的本能，这为我们提供了无价的数据。
entries.en:
$federations3.2015.intro$

As best the researchers can tell: this hyperspace-dwelling entity drifted into our federation space by accident, whereupon it became 'snagged' on our busiest, spaceborne communications relays - those which serve our capital starbases. Researchers agree that the gaseous entity was §Hattempting to reconstitute itself§! - a task it could otherwise not achieve in such a fragmented state.

After it reformed, the cloud disappeared back into hyperspace - but not before visiting a number of our alliance's research stations. At each one, it performed a number of precise movements in and out of hyperspace - a display which some witnesses describe as resembling a dance. These demonstrations of the cloud's innate ability to traverse the hyperspace barrier have provided us all with invaluable data.

entries.zh:
$federations3.2015.intro$

我们收集到的数据并不完整，但足以推断出我们遭遇了一个格式塔存在：这个气态存在适于居住在超空间中。项目合作者提出理论，认为这朵云的各个部分在漂移过我们星系时被“钩在”了首都的恒星基地上。它似乎想要§H重组自身§!——但由于我方没有一致为其提供帮助，这朵云的某些部分渐渐散去，不再能参与到重组中了。

那些成功重组的部分随后消失去了超空间之中；余下的部分可以继续为研究者提供关于超空间的、有趣的遥测数据。
entries.en:
$federations3.2015.intro$

The data we have is incomplete, but is enough to suggest we have encountered a gestalt being: gaseous in form, and adapted to dwelling in hyperspace. Project coordinators theorize that various parts of the cloud became 'snagged' on our capital starbases whilst it drifted through our galaxy. It appears to have wanted to §Hreconstitute itself§! - but without a united effort on our part, some of those clouds have begun to lose cohesion, and may no longer be able to rejoin.

Those parts of the cloud which did reunite soon vanished into hyperspace; what remains continues to provide researchers with interesting telemetry on matters relating to hyperspace.

entries.zh: 这样的话，或许能从中得到某些益处。
entries.en: Some benefit may yet be gleaned, then.

entries.zh: 由于我们没有对这一项目进行合作研究，关于这个造访我们首都的跨维度云团，我们很难确切得到些什么。理论众说纷纭，但我们都观察到这些云团变得相当躁动。\n\n它们的物理结构开始解体，我们注意到这些云团对于刺激的反应也减少了。它们开始更为迅速地穿入穿出超空间。这在我们的通讯频段上产生了显著的静态干扰，但也为[root.Capital.GetName]的理论研究者提供了宝贵的数据。
entries.en: With no collaborative effort having been applied this project, little can be said with any certainty about the pan-dimensional cloud visiting our capitals. Theories abound, but all of us are now witness to these clouds' stormy agitation.\n\nAs their physical structure breaks down, we note that the clouds become less responsive to stimuli. They have begun phasing in and out of hyperspace much more rapidly. This is generating a significant amount of static on many of our communications bands, but it is also providing valuable data for our theoretical researchers in [root.Capital.GetName].
§H[Root.GetAllianceName]§! receives a temporary boost to cohesion.\n\n

entries.zh: 通过协助一团造访我们联邦成员国首都、居住于超空间的气态实体，我们已经获得了对于超光速生物学及理论物理学的独特洞见。
entries.en: By aiding a gaseous, hyperspace-dwelling entity which once visited our federation's capitals, we have been granted unique insights into superluminary biology and theoretical physics.

entries.zh: 在我们联邦成员国首都与一团居住于超空间的气态来访者的偶然邂逅，这给予了我们关于超光速物理学的多种洞见。
entries.en: A chance encounter with a gaseous, hyperspace-dwelling visitor to our federation's capitals has granted us various insights into superluminary physics.

entries.zh: 我们牺牲了这一区域的某些信号保真性，以换取对一个被我们恒星基地信号传输引诱来的、居于超空间的生物及超光速物理学的洞见。
entries.en: We have sacrificed some signal fidelity in this region in return for insights into superluminary physics, courtesy of a hyperspace-dwelling creature which was lured in by our starbase transmissions.

entries.zh: 驶入[event_target:leylines_world.GetName]大气层的短程飞船报告，称其舰体上有奇怪的声音。声音的来源似乎在行星的地表之下，其所在地区富含稀有矿物。\n\n我们在[from.Federation.GetName]的同事监督的星球也报告过类似事件。
entries.en: Short-range vessels whose routes take them into the atmosphere of [event_target:leylines_world.GetName] report a strange sound assaulting their hulls. The source seems to lie just below the planet's surface, in an area rich in unusual minerals.\n\nSimilar occurrences have also been reported on worlds overseen by our colleagues in the [from.Federation.GetName].

entries.zh: $federations3.2103.desc.body$为应对此事，他们组成了一个由[event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName]领导的委员会，负责协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
entries.en: $federations3.2103.desc.body$ They have responded by forming a committee led by [event_target:leylines_coordinator.GetName], there to co-ordinate any excavation effort we all may wish to take part in.

entries.zh: $federations3.2103.desc.body$为应对此事，他们让我们领导委员会，协调我们都想要参与的挖掘工作。
entries.en: $federations3.2103.desc.body$ They have responded by tasking us with leadership of a committee, coordinating any excavation effort we all may wish to take part in.

entries.zh: 我们曾经以为，这不过是位于[From.Planet.GetName]上的鸡肋矿物层。但现在，这片矿物层却开始发出震耳欲聋的奇怪嗡嗡声。这还不是个例，联邦境内的诸星球上均可以听到类似的声音。这一异常现象背后究竟隐藏着什么？
entries.en: What was once thought to be merely a seam of half-interesting minerals on [From.Planet.GetName] has begun emitting a bizarre and deafening hum - and it's not alone. Worlds across federation space are being buffeted by a similar noise. Whatever could be behind these singular phenomena?

entries.zh: 我们在[root.Federation.GetName]的同事报告称听到了震耳欲聋的嗡嗡声，他认为声音的来源应该在地表之下，至少存在于一个星球中。他们成立了一个研究委员会，旨在支持他们的挖掘工作。\n\n他们要求我们提供自己的额外资源，以便我们能够更好地理解这件奇怪的麻烦事。
entries.en: Our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] report a deafening hum from sources thought to lie buried on at least one of their worlds. A research committee has been established to support any excavation efforts they make.\n\nWe have been asked to provide our own, additional resources, in order that we might all better understand this strange and inconvenient occurrence.

entries.zh: 我们会尽自己所能提供支持。
entries.en: We will lend what support we can.

entries.zh: 我们的联邦境内，至少有一颗行星发出震耳欲聋的嗡嗡声。由于我们的同事正在努力挖掘这一遗迹，他们要求我们提供自己的科学资源支持其工作。
entries.en: A deafening hum rings out across at least one planet in our federation's space. As our colleagues work to excavate these sites, we have been asked to lend our own scientific resources to the effort.

entries.zh: 我们的联邦同事正在极度嘈杂的环境中努力进行挖掘工作，为协助他们，我们的任务是改进所有人的隔音罩。考古学家目前只能断断续续地轮班，暂时还没有出现身体不适的迹象。
entries.en: In order to assist our federation colleagues amidst exceedingly noisy conditions, we have been tasked with refining their personnel's acoustic shields. The archaeologists are currently unable to work anything more than staccato shifts before they show signs of physical distress.

entries.zh: 我们未能向同事提供他们要求的额外隔音罩。好在设备匮乏只会阻碍他们的工作，并不会彻底阻止他们挖掘。但是，这还是让一线研究人员更加不安。纵使报告显示噪音现在正自己减弱，他们的情绪也没有任何好转。\n\n[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会现在邀请我们研究声音本身，看看能否得到些许启发，以此来弥补我们之前的过失。
entries.en: We have failed to provide our colleagues with the additional acoustic shielding they had requested. This lack of equipment will only hamper their efforts, and won't stall them outright. Nevertheless, it has left their front-line researchers that bit more rattled, even after reports which suggest that the noise is now subsiding of its own accord.\n\nThe [root.Federation.GetName] project committee now invites us to make amends by contributing to a study of the sound itself, to see if that may shed any light.

entries.zh: 我们已成功提高了折叠隔音罩的覆盖范围和适应力，并与[root.Federation.GetName]的同事共享了这些升级成果。他们的一线研究员报告称意识不清和身体剧痛的情况已经有了极大改善。协调委员会现在要求我们协助进行数据分析。
entries.en: We have succeeded in improving the reach and resilience of our deployable acoustic shields. These upgrades have been shared with our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName]; their researchers on the ground already report a steep decline in cognitive distress and deep-body aching. The co-ordination committee now asks us to assist with a matter of data analysis.

entries.zh: 我们在[root.Federation.GetName]的同事已经开始进行下一阶段的挖掘工作，但是每个受影响的星球仍然会发出噪音，因此项目监督委员会委托我们研究这些逐渐减弱的噪音。
entries.en: Now that our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] have begun the next stage of their excavations, the project's oversight committee has delegated us to study the waning din which still emanates from each affected world.

entries.zh: 我们未能得出令人满意的成果，[root.Federation.GetName]项目委员会对此表示失望。困扰联邦内多个星球的噪音终于消失，但研究机会的窗口也随之关闭。研究人员尽自己所能收集了一些信息，但现在只能寄希望于现场的考古学家能够给出详细的答案。
entries.en: The [root.Federation.GetName] project committee expresses its disappointment in our lack of results. As the din which has afflicted a number of our federated worlds finally dimmed, so too did the window of research opportunities close. Researchers gathered what insights they could, but any hope for detailed answers now rests solely with the archaeologists on the ground.

entries.zh: 联邦境内处考古遗址中的嗡鸣已经开始减弱。通过研究每种声音的录音，并将我们与同事的数据进行交叉对比，我们发现，当震耳欲聋的嗡鸣相互重叠时，会产生惊艳绝伦的和声，旋律可绕梁三日，令人心旷神怡。对于建造这些遗址的人来说，这种设计可能具有文化意义，但我们可能永远无法了解其中的含义。研究仍在继续……
entries.en: The humming at archaeological sites across our federation's space has begun to subside. By studying recordings of each sound - and cross-referencing our data with that of our colleagues - we discovered a surprising harmony as each deafening blast overlaps to form a more pleasant, ambient melody. It's possible that this arrangement held cultural significance for whoever developed these sites; we may never know. The research continues...

entries.zh: 声震屋瓦的贝壳形建筑
尽管我们必须断断续续地轮班工作，但从技术上讲，揭开这个遗址的奥秘非常简单。我们挖开了两层平平无奇的岩石，然后才看到一个大贝壳，也可以说是穹顶。此外，附近有一些相同的穹顶也已部分出土，目前看来，这些穹顶似乎排列成弧形或圆形。\n\n每个穹顶都是用模子建成，并且进行过一定程度的加固，能够经受地质年代的考验。每个建筑都有会议室大小，因此应该能够进入其中。
entries.en: The work of uncovering this site was technically straightforward - despite our having to work in staccato shifts. We removed two featureless strata before encountering a large shell or dome. Other, identical domes have been partially uncovered nearby; so far they seem to be arranged in an arc or circle.\n\nEach dome was constructed from a mold, and was cured to such a degree that they have withstood geological ages.
