Ingress to these structures - each of which is the size of a gathering hall - should be possible.

entries.zh: 尽管我们尚未确定无处不在的嗡鸣的来源，但其主导地位已经开始有所减弱。自此以后，我们的研究人员就能够专注突破这座类似半球的建筑。\n\n里面的空间完全没有实际内容，我们初步结论为，此建筑是按感官隔离室设计的。此外，穹顶的内表面似乎画有星座图，辅以神话人物和某种形式的经文。我们正在努力解读这些设计。
entries.en: While we have yet to identify the source of the pervasive humming, its dominating presence has begun to wane. Our researchers were since able to focus on breaching the near-hemispherical structure.\n\nThe space within is entirely devoid of material contents; our initial conclusion is that this was designed as a sensory isolation chamber. Furthermore, the inside surface of the dome is illustrated with what appear to be constellation charts, supplemented by mythical figures and some form of scripture. We are already working to interpret these designs.

entries.zh: 贝壳形建筑的内部结构
我们在穹顶内部发现了大量精巧的设备，但没有一台能够产生我们在外面还能听到的巨大噪音。一支小规模的工作小队已经独立出去，继续我们的调查工作。\n\n大部分研究人员还留在这个贝壳形结构中，研究其内部机制，设备结构复杂，装饰美观，乍一看像是某种大型计算器。
entries.en: We discovered a plethora of elaborate equipment inside the dome, none of which seems capable of producing the immense noise we can still hear outside. A small task force has split off to continue that aspect of our investigation.\n\nThe bulk of our researchers remain within the shell-like structure, studying the mechanisms within. The equipment is intricate, decorative in form, and seems at first glance to be some form of vast calculator.

entries.zh:
来自[From.Owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都确认：嗡鸣现已消失。尽管各星际遗址之间距离遥远，但嗡鸣声几乎在同一时间停止。

从那以后，我们的研究团队依据穹顶内部描绘的众多星座推断出了一些模型，这些星座通常用于占星预测。研究人员收集的数据表明，此设施，若是按年代排序，比周围地层要古老得多——但有一处明显的例外：研究人员偶然在穹顶外面发现了一个大型祭坛，这表明在相对较近的年代，至少有一个文明曾使用过这一空间。

祭台使用当地的石头凿成，上面雕有蚀刻图，我们认为这些蚀刻图是用来翻译穹顶上的古老星图，将其转化一个现今我们更为熟悉的星图。
entries.en:
Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the droning sirens have now dissipated. They ceased almost simultaneously, despite the vast distances between interstellar sites.

Since that time, our research team has extrapolated models from the many constellations depicted on the dome's interior, which seems to have been used to make astrological predictions. The data they've gathered suggests that this facility is far older than the surrounding strata, by an order of epochs - with one notable exception: the chance discovery of a large dais immediately outside the dome suggests that at least one civilization has used this space comparatively recently.

The dais was hewn from local stone, and is decorated with etchings we believe were used to translate the dome's outdated star charts for a galaxy arranged much as it is for us, now.

entries.zh: 来自[From.Owner.Federation.GetName]各地的报告都表明：困扰我们共有空间各处研究遗址的嗡鸣声已经消失。这让我们的研究人员如释重负，因为他们可以开始研究穹顶内安置的复杂设备了。\n\n尽管其设计古怪之极，但我们仍然辨认出，该设备由相互连接的太阳系仪组成。这些模型描绘了整个[From.Planet.System.GetName]星系和另外两个恒星系，但我们以及联邦内的同事至今仍不知道这两个星系的名称和位置。每台太阳系仪都由一组轴和齿轮驱动，支撑着无数由方解石和石化树液制成的雕塑。尽管看起来一动不动，但实际上它们正以缓慢的速度移动——就像巨大的星系时钟的一枝一节，而时钟的“钟声”可能就是我们先前听到的巨大嗡鸣。
entries.en: Reports from across the [From.Owner.Federation.GetName] confirm: the ringing hum which was plaguing research sites across our shared space has now dissipated. This came as relief to our researchers as they investigated the complex equipment arranged inside the dome.\n\nAlthough its design is eccentric in the extreme, we've identified it as an arrangement of interlinked orreries. These models depict the entirety of [From.Planet.System.GetName] along with two other star systems, whose names and positions are not yet known - to us nor our federation colleagues. Each is driven by a nest of axles and gears, supporting myriad sculptures in calcite and fossilized sap. Although they appear quite still, they are actually moving at a glacial pace - like parts of a vast galactic timepiece, whose 'chimes' might be the great siren we heard earlier.

entries.zh:
我们对[from.Planet.GetName]和其他地方穹顶的研究已结束。每个遗址都是巨大的占星设备，跨越星际的距离与其他设备同步。

我们的研究表明，这类设施被视为宇宙能量的汇聚点，影响着建造设施的古老文明的总体“位置感”。蚀刻记录中提到，议会将“引导”这些能量，从而指引其帝国的命运。

他们的社会最终依然走向衰落，这种仪式并没有为其逆天改命。但在之后的一千年中，出现了一个继业的文明，这一继承者文明翻译并恢复了这一仪式。那之后，他们也离开了这些地方，不知去了何处。

这块巨大的时钟至少已经见证了两个文明的兴衰。现在，时钟的自动嗡鸣召唤着我们，让我们在太空区域各处见证这一仪式。无论是否会有确切结果，至少[from.owner.Federation.GetName]已经准备好进行观察了……
entries.en:
Our study of the domes on [From.Planet.GetName] and elsewhere has reached an end. Each site is a vast astrological device, synchronized with others like it across interstellar distances.

Our studies suggest that facilities like this one were treated as focal points for cosmic energy, affecting a general 'sense of place' for the ancient civilization which built them. Etched records speak of councils who would 'channel' these energies in order to guide their empire's fortunes.

Such observances did not halt their society's eventual decline, but in the millennia which followed there also came an inheritor who would translate and revive the practice. They too have since left these sites, for parts unknown.

The vast timepiece has slowly ticked on through the periods of at least two civilizations; its automated siren has now called on us to observe this ritual at sites across our region of space. Whether or not anything tangible results from it, the [from.owner.Federation.GetName] is now poised to observe...

entries.zh:
有人可能会说，我们直到最后一刻才收集完数据。联邦最新成果刚刚发布没几天，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几个圆顶遗址就突然活跃起来，一束束光从地下深处飞流直上，正好映照在我们首都上方，这让人难以置信。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。广播只传达了一个目的，即宣告这件事成为“§H求索的时刻§!”。

没有关于后续现象的报告，圆顶遗址又一次变暗，继续缓慢地像时钟一样滴答地走过一个个时代，当然也包括我们当下的时代。
entries.en:
One might say that the last of our data was gathered in the nick of time. Mere days after the last of our federation's findings was published, each domed site within [from.Federation.GetName] space burst into life. Cascades of light spilled upwards from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers are puzzled - how could the makers of these sites know? - but those on [root.Capital.GetName] are more concerned with a swath of dreamlike visions which briefly appeared on every device with a visual output. The broadcast 'spoke' with singular purpose, proclaiming this to be a '§HTime of Knowing§!'.

No subsequent phenomena have been reported; the domed sites dimmed again, and have resumed their glacial 'ticking' through ages which now include our own.
Genius Caeli: A Time of Knowing

entries.zh: 我们合作研究了一台奇怪的占星设备，从而获得了新的认知：古老的唯心主义社会有关扩展知识的预测。
entries.en: Our collaborative study of a strange, astrological device has granted us insight: the knowledge-expanding predictions of an ancient, spiritualist society.

entries.zh:
一刹那，[from.Federation.GetName]境内几座圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。

我们的研究人员也很困惑，遗址的建造者怎么会知道这些？但是[root.Capital.GetName]的人民更关心一连串梦幻般的景象，所有人都亲眼见证了这短暂的景象。尽管还不清楚广播的目的，但人们共同见证这一景象凸显出一种§H平衡繁荣§!的情感氛围。

没有关于后续现象的报告，圆顶遗址又一次变暗，继续神秘而缓慢地像时钟一样滴答作响。
entries.en:
Each of the once-noisy, domed sites within [from.Federation.GetName] space has, for a brief moment, burst into life. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.

Our researchers are puzzled - how could the makers of these sites know? - but those on [root.Capital.GetName] are more concerned with a swath of dreamlike visions which briefly appeared on every device with a visual output. It's unclear what the broadcast was intended for, but a commonly-shared observation highlights feelings of §Hbalanced prosperity§!.

No subsequent phenomena have been reported; the domed sites dimmed again, and have resumed their mysterious, glacial 'ticking'.

entries.zh: 我们合作研究了一台奇怪的占星设备，从而获得了新的认知：古老的唯心主义社会有关可持续性的教训。
entries.en: Our collaborative study of a strange, astrological device has granted us insight: lessons in sustainability, from an ancient, spiritualist society.

entries.zh: 整个[from.Federation.GetName]的智能生物都为眼前突然出现的宏伟景象所震惊。与此同时，几年前发现的古老圆顶遗址突然活跃起来。据报告，一束束光从地下深处的源头倾泻而出，正好映照在我们首都上方，这简直不可思议。\n\n我们在[root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员对这种梦幻般的景象感到非常困惑。目前我们还不清楚这一现象的目的，也没有观测到后续现象，因此无法获得更多线索。我们似乎错过了对其加以研究的时机。
entries.en: Sapients throughout the [from.Federation.GetName] have been startled by a sudden, apparent hijacking of visual feeds which coincided with a burst of activity from ancient, domed sites discovered some years ago. Cascades of light were reported spilling out from sources deep underground, their beams cast squarely - and improbably - at our capitals.\n\nOur researchers on [root.Capital.GetName] are puzzled by this broadcast of dreamlike visions. It's unclear what it was intended for, and no subsequent phenomena have been reported which might lend us more clues. It would seem that we have simply missed an opportunity to study this phenomenon.

entries.zh: 即将进行的试点：物流重构

各种货物的运输路线是我们贸易联邦兴旺繁荣的生命线。但迄今为止，各帝国仍在容器设计、装载程序及运输管道等方面采用各自的物流标准。

为了使效率最大化，一个新的试点项目将在几年后实施——项目目标是调研并试验一种全新、具体，适用于联邦所有成员国的运输标准。

参与试点需要拥有一个至少有§H50点贸易额§!流经的恒星系。此外，设有§H外星贸易公司§!意味着更高的统计数据，所以应对其进行鼓励。

由于项目所涉范围广泛，一些开销必不可少。但这些牺牲是为了长远的利益。换句话说，也就是更多的未来利润。

联邦各成员国均被强烈鼓励参与项目。
entries.en:
The routing of various goods is the life-blood of our prosperous trade federation. But so far each empire has relied on their own logistic standards with regards to container design, loading procedures, and shipping pipelines.

In order to maximize efficiency, a new trial project will commence in a few years - one that aims to investigate and trial a new, specific shipping standard that would be applied to all members of the federation.

Participation requires a system with at least §H50 Trade§! flowing through it. Furthermore, the existence of an §HOffworld Trading Company§! would mean increased statistical data, and so is encouraged.

Due to the vast scope of this project, some costs will apply. But it's for the greater good. That is to say: more future profit.

Every member of the federation is strongly encouraged to participate.

entries.zh: 物流重构试点已经启动！多亏了我们帝国兴旺的贸易路线，§Y[From.GetName]§!已获准参与试点项目！一处恒星基地已被挑出，用作试验站点，现在我们需要指派一艘§H工程船§!，以实施实际的重构项目。时间也是一个因素，所以不要再作犹豫。\n\n我们还拥有一处§H外星贸易公司§!设施，正因如此，项目进度有所加快。公司所属的帝国将获得一些金融优待，以表感激。
entries.en: The logistical remodelling trial has begun! Thanks to the empire's vigorous trade routes, §Y[From.GetName]§! has been granted participation in the trial project! One starbase has been singled out as a test site, and now a §HConstruction Ship§! must be assigned to perform the actual remodelling project. Time is a factor, so do not linger in this endeavour.\n\nAn §HOffworld Trading Company§! facility is also available, and thanks to this, the project will be expedited. The empire will be granted some financial leniency as a token of gratitude.

entries.zh: 物流重构试点已经启动！多亏了我们帝国兴旺的贸易路线，§Y[From.GetName]§!已获准参与试点项目！一处恒星基地已被挑出，用作试验站点，现在我们需要指派一艘§H工程船§!，以实施实际的重构项目。时间也是一个因素，所以不要再作犹豫。\n\n我们没有§H外星贸易公司§!。这不会阻止我们参与试点，但会在一定程度上妨碍项目进度，因为我们无法与所涉各方分享有价值的信息，以便充分对其进行利用。
entries.en: The logistical remodelling trial has begun! Thanks to the empire's vigorous trade routes, §Y[From.GetName]§! has been granted participation in the trial project! One starbase has been singled out as a test site, and now a §HConstruction Ship§! must be assigned to perform the actual remodelling project. Time is a factor, so do not linger in this endeavour.\n\nAn §HOffworld Trading Company§! facility was not available. This doesn't stop our participation, but will impede progress somewhat as we cannot take full advantage of beneficial information-sharing between involved parties.

entries.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！但是，§Y[From.GetName]§!缺少参与试点所必需的设施。一个拥有充足贸易额流经的恒星系居然没有§H贸易中心§!，真是匪夷所思。

错过有潜在好处的项目算是个错误，但连能带来巨大贸易额的顶级商业机会也会错过？这简直是犯罪！

多么耻辱，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！多么耻辱啊！
entries.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! However, §Y[From.GetName]§! has been found lacking in facilities necessary for participation in the trial. The lack of a §HTrade Hub§! in a system with sufficient Trade flowing through it is nothing short of baffling.

To miss out on a potentially beneficial project is a mistake, but to miss out on such a supreme business opportunity as Trade? That's almost a crime!

For shame, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! For shame!

entries.zh: 恭喜！重构操作已经结束，专用的贸易中心正按照全新的物流标准运行。除了对这一恒星系进行评估之外，没什么需要做的了。\n\n在试验期结束时，关于试点项目结果的官方声明将会发布。
entries.en: Congratulations! The remodelling operation has finished and the dedicated Trade Hub is now operating to a new logistical standard. Nothing left to do now but to evaluate the new system.\n\nAt the end of the trial period there will be an official statement on how the trial project turned out.

entries.zh:
这是就贸易与利润而言意义深远的一天！不仅物流试点成功完成，其结果更是表明星际商业往来更为顺畅，贸易效率显著提升！

结果是，联邦内一切太空贸易操作均会逐步地、不知不觉地切换到新标准进行；整个联邦将由此极大受益。

为利润而欢呼吧！
entries.en:
This is a monumental day for profit and trade! Not only is the logistics trial complete, but the results show a noticeable increase in efficiency and smooth interstellar business!

As a result, all space trading operations in the federation will now progressively - and quite unnoticeably - switch over to the new standard; the federation will benefit tremendously.

Hurrah for profit!

entries.zh:
这是就贸易与商业而言伟大的一天。试验期已经结束，项目已得到完全评估。我们收集到足够的数据表明贸易效率有所提升，应当全面实施新的物流标准。

现在开始，一切运输操作将逐步切换到新标准——但这个过程是完全自动的。食品会被递送，消费品会被送到它们的目的地，香料仍在运输，如此这般。

总之，干得漂亮！
entries.en:
It's a great day for trade and commerce. The trial period is over, and the project has been fully evaluated. Enough data was collected to see an increase in efficiency that warrants full implementation of the new logistical standard.

Now begins a process in which all shipping operations will switch to the new standard - but this process is fully automatic. The foodstuff will be delivered, the consumer goods will reach their destination, the spice will flow, and so on.

Good job!

entries.zh:
如果联邦各成员国逐利的动机微弱到这种程度，那灰暗的时代确实来临了。

由于缺乏参与及动力到了令人费解的程度，这项大有前途的物流试点变成了一场闹剧！如今还剩的只有冗长乏味的指责、官司还有诉讼了。

去请个律师吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——会有些不良后果需要处理。
entries.en:
Grim times do indeed loom if this is the substandard motivation by which the federation's members pursue profit.

A baffling lack of participation and drive turned this promising logistical trial into nothing short of a farce! Now the only thing that remains is a tedious dance of blame, lawsuits and litigation.

Lawyer up, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there will be repercussions.

entries.zh: 由于没有积极参与正在进行的物流试点，这个帝国会被征收“惩罚税”。
entries.en: The lack of active participation in the ongoing logistical trial is met by a 'penalty tax' applied to the empire.

entries.zh: 物流重构项目或许会在未来有所回报，但实施项目还是有开销的。
entries.en: The logistical remodelling project may bear fruit in the future, but its implementation still carries a cost.

entries.zh: 多亏了所涉公司的合作，物流重构项目的开销有所降低。
entries.en: Thanks to cooperation between involved companies, the cost of the logistical remodelling project is lowered.

entries.zh: 联邦正从已实施的一体化物流标准中得到好处。
entries.en: The federation is reaping the rewards of having implemented a consolidated logistical standard.

entries.zh: 联邦正享有可观的利润提升，这要归功于全新的流线物流标准。
entries.en: The federation is enjoying a noticeable profit increase thanks to new, streamlined logistical standards.

entries.zh: 为了对全新的物流标准进行试点，这一恒星基地的相关设施需要进行重大的结构性改造。\n\n指派一艘§Y工程船§!到这个项目，确保项目按时完成！
entries.en: In order to try out the new logistical standards, the relevant facilities on this starbase need to undergo some major structural alterations.\n\nAssign a §YConstruction Ship§! to the project, and make sure it's done on time!

entries.zh: 为了对全新的物流标准进行试点，这一恒星基地的相关设施需要进行重大的结构性改造。多亏了本地的§H外星贸易公司§!，项目会进行的更为高效。\n\n指派一艘§Y工程船§!到这个项目，确保项目按时完成！
entries.en: In order to try out the new logistical standards, the relevant facilities on this starbase need to undergo some major structural alterations. Thanks to the local §HOffworld Trading Company§! this project will be more efficient.\n\nAssign a §YConstruction Ship§! to the project, and make sure it's done on time!

entries.zh: 联邦团结暨领导力盛典
entries.en: A Celebration of Unity and Leadership

entries.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]在我国的明智领导下繁荣昌盛。许多[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如今感到是时候因我们为盟友提供的服务获得回报了，我们将举办一场团结盛典——更确切地说，是为向联邦无私奉献的伟大[Root.GetAdj]领袖们举办的盛典。他们提议各成员国合作在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一道丰碑，于此同时，我们将派遣代表团前往两个成员国的首都，协助他们为[Root.Federation.GetName]带来更多的凝聚力。
entries.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] has prospered under the wise leadership of our nation. Many [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] now feel that it is time for our services to the alliance to be paid back with a celebration of its unity - and more specifically, the great [Root.GetAdj] leaders that have done so much for it. They propose that member states contribute towards the erection of a grand monument in the skies above [Root.Capital.GetName], while in the meantime we send delegations to two member states' capitals to aid them in their efforts to bring greater unity to the [Root.Federation.GetName].

entries.zh:
所有能前往§H[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§!星系的成员国均会被邀请参与联合行动。

如果他们接受，他们必须投入资源建造纪念碑，这会增加联邦§H经验§!和[Root.GetName]的§H影响力§!。

[Root.GetName]还可以选择在两个成员国中提升§H[Root.GetHegemonyEthos]§!的吸引力。

如果这一提议遭到广泛拒绝，联邦§H团结度§!将会下降，[Root.GetName]会损失§H影响力§!。
entries.en:
All member states with access to the §H[Root.Capital.System.GetName]§! system will be approached to take part in the joint operation.

If they accept, they will have to dedicate resources to a monument which will boost Federation §HExperience§! and the [Root.GetName]'s §HInfluence§!.

The [Root.GetName] will also be able to choose to increase §H[Root.GetHegemonyEthos]§! attraction in two member states.

If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation §HCohesion§! will decrease and the [Root.GetName] will lose §HInfluence§!.
We have no need for such trinkets.

entries.zh: 你们好，尊贵的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]！在我们明智而宽宥的领导下，[Root.Federation.GetName]的实力与日俱增，我们共同目标遍及星海。是时候庆祝我们联合起来取得的成就了。还有什么会比各成员国合力在我国首都树立一座丰碑更合宜呢？与此同时，我国会派遣代表团前往贵国首都，协助你们求取[Root.Federation.GetName]的上上善道。\n\n你们愿意加入这次活动吗？
entries.en: Greetings, noble [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]! Under our wise and magnanimous leadership, the [Root.Federation.GetName] has gone from strength to strength, projecting our unity of purpose across the galaxy. The time has come to celebrate our joint successes as a union. What better way to do this than through a grand monument over our capital, erected through the efforts of the member states? In the meantime, we will send a delegation to your capital, which will aid your efforts to strive for the greater good of the [Root.Federation.GetName].\n\nWill you join this venture?

entries.zh:
所有能前往§H[From.Capital.System.GetName]§!星系的成员国均会被邀请参与联合行动。

如果他们接受，他们必须投入资源建造纪念碑，这会增加联邦§H经验§!和[From.GetName]的§H影响力§!。

[From.GetName]还可以选择在两个成员国中提升§H[From.GetHegemonyEthos]§!的吸引力。
entries.en:
All member states with access to the §H[From.Capital.System.GetName]§! system will be approached to take part in the joint operation.

If they accept, they will have to dedicate resources to a monument which will boost Federation §HExperience§! and the [From.GetName]'s §HInfluence§!.

The [From.GetName] will also be able to choose to increase §H[From.GetHegemonyEthos]§! attraction in two member states.

entries.zh: \n完成纪念碑将花费[Root.GetName]£minerals£矿物年产量的10%。
entries.en: \nCompleting the monument will cost 10% of the [Root.GetName]'s £minerals£ mineral output for 1 year.

entries.zh: 在贵国首都树立丰碑？绝对不行！
entries.en: A monument over your capital? Absolutely not!

entries.zh: 如果这一提议遭到广泛拒绝，联邦§H团结度§!将会下降。
entries.en: If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation §HCohesion§! will decrease.

entries.zh: 我国大使就我国的团结盛典计划与[Root.Federation.GetName]各成员国进行了商洽。不幸的是，他们对这件事的看法似乎与我们不同，我们没能获得计划推进所必需的支持。
entries.en: Our ambassadors have approached the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] with our plans for a celebration of unity. Unfortunately, it seems that they do not feel the same way about the matter as we do, and we have been unable to muster sufficient support for the plan to proceed.

entries.zh: 他们如此缺乏信念，令人不安。

entries.en: \nThe following nations agreed to the plan:

entries.zh: 尽管有我们为[From.GetAdj]举办[Root.Federation.GetName]团结盛典的提议背书，这项计划似乎还是失败了。失败原因是其他成员国不愿提供足够支持。
entries.en: Despite our backing for the [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold a celebration of the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s unity, it seems that the plan has fallen through. There was simply not enough support for it among the other member states.

entries.zh: 我们对[Root.Federation.GetName]中[From.GetAdj]专横的联合行动计划的反对有了成效。震惊于这项计划打算在成员国间播撒[From.GetAdj]宣传，这项提议被各方广泛回绝。
entries.en: Our opposition to the overbearing [From.GetAdj] plans for a joint operation in the [Root.Federation.GetName] has borne fruit. Appalled at the plans for missions to spread [From.GetAdj] propaganda among the member states, the proposals were roundly rejected by all parties.

entries.zh: 是时候在联盟内先破后立了。
entries.en: Perhaps it is time to shake things up in this alliance.

entries.zh: 我们关于举办一场联合盛典，庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的力量与团结的计划已获大多数成员国认可。我们将立刻开始致力于实施这项计划，增进联盟内的和谐。
entries.en: Our initiative to hold a joint celebration of the strength and unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has met with approval among the majority of members. We will begin work on implementing our plans to spread harmony within the alliance immediately!

entries.zh: 所有参与的成员国获得在§H[federation_leader.Capital.GetName]§!上建造纪念碑的特殊项目。\n§H[federation_leader.GetName]§!获得特殊项目，可以向至多两个成员国传播§H[federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos]§!思潮。
entries.en: All participating members gain a special project to build a monument on §H[federation_leader.Capital.GetName]§!.\nThe §H[federation_leader.GetName]§! gains special projects to spread the §H[federation_leader.GetHegemonyEthos]§! ethos to up to two member states.

entries.zh: [From.GetAdj]关于举办一场联合盛典，庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的力量与团结的计划已获大多数成员国认可。我们将立即开始工作，以便计划早日落实！
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold a joint celebration of the strength and unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has met with approval among the majority of members. We will begin work to make the plans a reality immediately!

entries.zh: 尽管我国反对，[Root.Federation.GetName]中[From.GetAdj]专横的联合行动计划得到了大多数成员国的认可。幸好，[From.GetName]无法强迫我国参与这项计划。
entries.en: Despite our opposition, overbearing [From.GetAdj] plans for a joint operation in the [Root.Federation.GetName] have met with approval among the majority of members. Fortunately, there is nothing the [From.GetName] can do to force us to participate in the scheme.

entries.zh: 为了向[From.GetName]在[Root.Federation.GetName]中提供的强力领导致以敬意，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已经得到成员国认可，举行一场关于联盟团结的联合庆典。成员国同意投入资源，在[From.Capital.GetName]的天空中树立一座丰碑，同时[From.GetAdj]代表团将访问若干国家的首都，协助成员国融入联盟。\n\n由于我国位置偏远，很难前往[From.Capital.GetName]，我们无法参与这一计划。
entries.en: In honor of the strong leadership offered by the [From.GetName] in the [Root.Federation.GetName], the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have secured approval among its members for a joint celebration of our alliance's unity. Member states have agreed to dedicate resources to a grand monument in the skies above [From.Capital.GetName], while [From.GetAdj] delegations will visit various capitals to aid the integration of the member states into the alliance.\n\nGiven our remote location, with no easy access to [From.Capital.GetName], we are unable to participate in the scheme.

entries.zh: 联邦团结暨伟大领导盛典
entries.en: A Celebration of Unity and Great Leadership

entries.zh: 一项联合行动已经开始，[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国将以此庆祝其强有力的领导并推动意识形态上的团结。
entries.en: A joint operation has been launched between members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] to celebrate its strong leadership and push for greater ideological unity.

entries.zh: 作为当前庆祝[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]强力领导暨意识形态团结的联合行动的一部分，代表团将被派往两个成员国的首都，以监督其更紧密地融入联盟。\n\n一旦两个成员国已被选定，文化调整项目将被视作完成。
entries.en: As part of the current joint operation to celebrate the strong leadership and ideological unity of the [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName], a delegation shall be sent to two members' capitals in order to supervise their closer integration into the alliance.\n\nOnce the two member states have been chosen, the cultural adjustment program will be deemed complete.

entries.zh: 为了庆贺[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]的凝聚力和实力，我们目前正在执行联合行动。作为行动的一部分，我们已经同意向[This.GetName]运送资源，以建造献给[This.Owner.GetAdj]领袖们的丰碑。\n\n我们将为此项目献出£minerals£矿物年产量的10%。
entries.en: As part of the current joint operation to celebrate the unity and strength of the [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName], we have agreed to send resources to [This.GetName] for the construction of a grand monument to our [This.Owner.GetAdj] leaders.\n\nWe will have to contribute 10% of our £minerals£ mineral output for a year to this project.

entries.zh: 我们派去[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]宣扬[Root.GetHegemonyEthos]理想的代表团已于[FromFrom.GetName]落脚。幸运的话，他们的努力会有回报，[Root.Federation.GetName]内将更为和谐。
entries.en: Our delegation to spread [Root.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] has established itself on [FromFrom.GetName]. With luck, their efforts will bear fruit and increase harmony within the [Root.Federation.GetName].

entries.zh: 作为当前联邦联合行动的一部分，[From.Owner.GetAdj][From.Owner.GetGovernmentName]已经派出代表团前往[FromFrom.GetName]，以在[Root.GetName]宣扬[From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos]理想。尽管他们宣称这是为了在[Root.Federation.GetName]内增进和谐与善意，许多人担忧我们自己的价值观会因我们在联邦中的成员国资格受损。
entries.en: As part of the current federation joint operations, the [From.Owner.GetAdj] [From.Owner.GetGovernmentName] has sent delegates to [FromFrom.GetName] to spread [From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [Root.GetName]. Although they claim to be promoting harmony and goodwill within the [Root.Federation.GetName], many are concerned that our own values are being compromised by our membership in the alliance.

entries.zh: 作为当前联邦联合行动的一部分，[From.Owner.GetAdj][From.Owner.GetGovernmentName]已经派出代表团前往[FromFrom.GetName]，以在[Root.GetName]宣扬[From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos]理想。幸好，他们的价值观念与我们一致，相信这一定会增进[Root.Federation.GetName]内的和谐与善意。
entries.en: As part of the current federation joint operations, the [From.Owner.GetAdj] [From.Owner.GetGovernmentName] has sent delegates to [FromFrom.GetName] to spread [From.Owner.GetHegemonyEthos] ideals in the [Root.GetName]. Fortunately, their values align well with our own, lending credence to their claim to be promoting harmony and goodwill within the [Root.Federation.GetName].
Surely only good can come of this.
We'll see what comes of this...

entries.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结及[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。他们对我们的付出表示感谢，但在纪念碑正式揭幕前尚需等待我们的联邦盟友完成贡献。
entries.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName], celebrating the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. They thank us for our offering, although they await the contributions of our federation allies before the monument is officially unveiled.

entries.zh: 在所有成员国贡献完成后，联邦将收到经验增益。
entries.en: Once all members have completed their contributions, the Federation will gain an experience boost.

entries.zh: 揭幕式上锣鼓喧天，各成员国的星球上一片沸腾，我们纪念碑的华丽光彩清晰地映入眼帘。成员国间奋勇争先，没有任何偷工减料。最终的成果——原本献给[FromFrom.Owner.GetAdj][FromFrom.Owner.GetRulerTitle]——如今向所有人证明了我们联邦的团结与力量。
entries.en: It has been unveiled to much fanfare, sparking celebrations across all member worlds as the splendor of our creation became clear. Each member competed with all others to outdo them in their contribution, with none slacking off. The work - originally dedicated to the [FromFrom.Owner.GetAdj] [FromFrom.Owner.GetRulerTitle] - now stands as evidence for all to see, of the strength and togetherness of our federation.

entries.zh: 揭幕式上锣鼓喧天，各成员国的星球上一片沸腾，我们纪念碑的华丽光彩清晰地映入眼帘。几乎所有成员国都投入了可观的努力，最终成果是我们联盟力量与团结的典范。
entries.en: It has been unveiled to much fanfare, sparking celebrations across member worlds as the splendor of our creation became clear. Nearly all member states gave significant contributions, making the work a fine example of our union's strength and togetherness.

entries.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明而庄严的领导。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$
entries.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the august and enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. $hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$

entries.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。$hegemony_federation_monument_partial_success$
entries.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. $hegemony_federation_monument_partial_success$

entries.zh: 我们已经完成了就[FromFrom.GetName]纪念碑的工作，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明领导。不过，我们的盟友似乎不如我们这般支持这项提案，大多数成员国除了空话以外再无贡献。最终的纪念碑了无趣味——与其说是反映了联盟的共同感和力量，不如说是尴尬地象征着同盟间的分歧。
entries.en: We have completed our work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the enlightened leadership offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. However, it seems that our allies did not support the initiative as strongly as we did, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.
At least we did our part.

entries.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的开明而庄严的领导的工作已经完成。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$

However, it seems that our allies did not support the initiative as strongly as we did, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

entries.zh: 我国盟友在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”和[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提供的“开明领导”的工作已经完成。不过，对这项提案的支持不如[FromFrom.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望的那样有力，大多数成员国除了空话以外再无贡献。最终的纪念碑了无趣味——与其说是反映了联盟的共同感和力量，不如说是尴尬地象征着同盟间的分歧。
entries.en: Our allies have finished their work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the "enlightened leadership" offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]. It seems that commitment to the initiative was not as strong as the [FromFrom.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] had hoped, however, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

entries.zh: 由[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]提议，在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”和“开明领导”的计划今天已被正式取消。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_failure$
entries.en: Plans for a monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and the "enlightened leadership" offered by the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have officially been cancelled today. $hegemony_federation_monument_complete_failure$

entries.zh: 同盟中没有成员国愿意为计划做除了空话之外的贡献，也就是说这个纪念碑只算是又一个不切实际的构想——一个失败的点子，表现不出任何共同感或是力量，反而象征着我们之间的分歧。
entries.en: Not one member of the alliance committed anything but hollow words to the initiative, meaning that the monument will go down as just another unrealized scheme - a failed idea symbolic more of our divisions than any common feeling or strength.

entries.zh: 也许是时候先破后立了。
entries.en: Perhaps it is time for a shake-up.

entries.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑，以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的团结和我们提供的开明而庄严的领导的工作已经完成。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$
entries.en: Work has been completed on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the unity of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and our august and enlightened leadership. $hegemony_federation_monument_complete_success$

entries.en: Our allies have finished their work on the monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and our "enlightened leadership". It seems that commitment to the initiative was not as strong as we had hoped, however, and a majority of federation members did not contribute much beyond empty words. The resulting monument is therefore rather lackluster - an embarrassment more symbolic of our alliance's divisions than any common feeling or strength.

entries.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑以庆祝[Root.Federation.GetName]的“团结”及我们的“开明领导”的计划今天已被正式取消。$hegemony_federation_monument_complete_failure$
entries.en: Plans for a monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the [Root.Federation.GetName] and our "enlightened leadership" have officially been cancelled today. $hegemony_federation_monument_complete_failure$

entries.zh: 有了我们的领导，所有人都更为强大。
entries.en: Under our leadership, all are stronger.

entries.zh: 也许依赖我们的盟友是个错误。
entries.en: Perhaps we were wrong to rely on our allies.

entries.zh: 由于联邦领袖的变更，旧有的歌颂[FromFrom.Owner.GetName]统治者的计划已被搁置。
entries.en: With the change in federation leadership, the old plans to glorify the rulers of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have been duly shelved.
The old king is dead; long live the king.

entries.zh: 由于我们已经脱离了旧有的联邦，在[FromFrom.GetName]建造纪念碑以庆祝同盟凝聚力的计划与我们再无关联。
entries.en: As we have left our old federation, plans to construct a monument over [FromFrom.GetName] to celebrate the "unity" of the alliance are no longer relevant to us.

entries.zh: 由于[FromFrom.GetName]不再是我们联邦的中心，旧有的歌颂该行星统治者的计划已经搁置。
entries.en: As [FromFrom.GetName] is no longer the center of our federation, the old plans to glorify the planet's rulers have been duly shelved.

entries.zh: 这座太空中的纪念碑象征着建造它的联邦的团结、力量与光彩。
entries.en: This spaceborne monument stands witness to the unity, strength and splendor of the interstellar federation that constructed it.

entries.zh: 我们联邦的霸主正在我国宣扬军国主义价值观。
entries.en: The Hegemon of our Federation is spreading militarist values in our nation.

entries.zh: 我们联邦的霸主正在我国宣扬和平主义价值观。
entries.en: The Hegemon of our Federation is spreading pacifist values in our nation.

entries.zh: 我们联邦的霸主正在我国宣扬排外主义价值观。
entries.en: The Hegemon of our Federation is spreading xenophobia in our nation.

entries.en: The Hegemon of our Federation is spreading xenophilia in our nation.

entries.zh: 我们联邦的霸主正在我国宣扬唯物主义价值观。
entries.en: The Hegemon of our Federation is spreading materialist values in our nation.

entries.zh: 我们联邦的霸主正在我国宣扬唯心主义价值观。
entries.en: The Hegemon of our Federation is spreading spiritualist values in our nation.

entries.zh: 我们联邦的霸主正在我国宣扬平等主义价值观。
entries.en: The Hegemon of our Federation is spreading egalitarian values in our nation.

entries.zh: 我们联邦的霸主正在我国宣扬威权主义价值观。
entries.en: The Hegemon of our Federation is spreading authoritarian values in our nation.

entries.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]代表星系舞台上一股强大的力量，但是其舰队分散在各处，并且在不同的组织结构下运作。近日，联邦各地几位颇具影响力的军事专家对我们能否面对协调统一、实力强大的敌人表示担忧。\n\n为弥补实力上的不足，他们制定了一套方案，计划在联邦范围内进行一系列军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。根据他们的计划，每支舰队将派出特遣队前往盟友领土的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。成功完成演习是我军的重要使命，将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。
entries.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName] represents a powerful force on the galactic stage; however, its fleets are divided and operate under a disparate set of organizational structures. Recently, several influential military experts from across the federation have raised concerns about our ability to face a well-coordinated and powerful enemy.\n\nTo rectify this, they have drawn up plans for a federation-wide series of military exercises to build cohesion within our militaries and hone the skills of our crews. Under their plans, detachments from each of our fleets would move to specific locations in our allies' territories and perform a series of complex maneuvers, coordinating with other participating fleets to ensure that the operations are executed simultaneously. Successfully holding these exercises would be a significant commitment for our armed forces but would appreciably boost our federation's military readiness.

entries.zh: 我们将与所有成员国联系，要求他们参加演习。\n\n如果大量成员国拒绝此提议，联邦§H团结度§!将会降低，而[Root.GetName]将损失§H影响力§!。
entries.en: All member states will be approached and asked to participate in the exercises.\n\nIf the proposal is widely rejected, Federation §HCohesion§! will decrease and the [Root.GetName] will lose §HInfluence§!.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队已准备好应对一切可能发生的情况。
entries.en: Our fleet is already ready for all eventualities.

entries.zh: 尊贵的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，你们好！我们齐心协力，打造了一股强大的力量，即使在星系舞台上也不容小觑。但是，我们担心，如果出现实力强大、协调统一的威胁，我们目前的实力可能不足以与之抗衡。我们的专家制定了一套方案，计划进行一系列联邦联合军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能：我们打算让每支舰队派出特遣队前往联邦领土内的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。\n\n我们相信，这些演习将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。你们愿意参与演习吗？
entries.en: Greetings, noble [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]! Together, we have built a powerful force worthy of notice on the galactic stage. However, we are concerned that this may not be enough should a powerful and well-coordinated threat arise. Our experts have drawn up plans for a series of joint federation exercises to build cohesion within our militaries and hone the skills of our crews: we intend that detachments from each of our fleets move to specific locations in federation territory and perform a series of complex maneuvers, coordinating with other participating fleets to ensure that the operations are executed simultaneously.\n\nWe are confident that these exercises would appreciably boost our federation's military readiness. Will you join this venture?

entries.zh: 完成联合演习将提高舰队效率，增加联邦经验。
entries.en: Completing these joint exercises will increase the efficiency of our fleet and provide a boost to federation experience.

entries.zh: 同意参加联合军事演习
我们没有可供你演习调用的舰队！
entries.en: We cannot spare any of our fleets for your games!

entries.zh: 拒绝参加联合军事演习
我们的大使已竭尽全力说服[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国参与我们的联合军事演习计划。但遗憾的是，我们的盟友普遍不感兴趣，比起提高联合作战能力，他们更愿意相信自己的力量。
entries.en: Our ambassadors have sought to persuade the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] to participate in our plans for joint military exercises. Unfortunately, however, they have been met with widespread disinterest, our allies preferring to trust in their own strength rather than seeking to improve our joint capacities.

entries.zh: 尽管我们支持举行联邦联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议，但由于其他成员国并未对此提供足够的支持，计划似乎已经宣告失败。
entries.en: Despite our backing for the [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold joint federation military exercises, it seems that the plan has fallen through. There was simply not enough support for it among the other member states.

entries.zh: 我们反对在[Root.Federation.GetName]举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]计划，并且反对声音已初见成效。大部分成员国都认为没必要把军队的注意力放在这种琐事上。
entries.en: Our opposition to [From.GetAdj] plans for joint military exercises in the [Root.Federation.GetName] has borne fruit. A majority of members saw no need to waste our military's attention on such trivialities.
It was never a sensible course of action.

entries.zh: 我们提出的在[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国之间举行联合军事演习的计划得到了大多数盟友的支持。所有参加的成员国将立即着手准备！
entries.en: Our plans for joint military exercises among the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] have been met with approval among a majority of our allies. All participating members will begin preparations immediately!

entries.zh: 集结舰队，让敌人颤抖吧！
entries.en: Together our fleets shall strike fear into our enemies!

entries.zh: 其他所有参与的成员国将在[Root.Federation.GetName]领土的随机地点，获取类似的特殊项目。
entries.en: All other participating members gain a similar special project in a random location in the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s territory.

entries.zh: 在联邦成员国舰队之间举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议得到了大部分成员国的支持。我们得尽快着手准备！
entries.en: The [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold joint military exercises between federation member states' fleets has met with approval among the majority of members. We shall begin our preparations for them immediately!

entries.zh: 尽管我们反对，但在联邦成员国舰队之间举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议得到了大部分成员国的支持。幸运的是，[From.GetName]没有办法强制要求我们参加这个计划。
entries.en: Despite our opposition, [From.GetAdj] plans to hold joint military exercises between federation member states' fleets has met with approval among the majority of members. Fortunately, there is nothing the [From.GetName] can do to force us to participate in the scheme.

entries.zh: 这是对时间和精力的浪费，真遗憾。
entries.en: An unfortunate waste of time and energy.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]正在举行联合军事演习，以便增强联盟内各个军队之间的凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。\n\n演习将在联邦舰队就位后立即开始。
entries.en: The [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName] is holding joint military exercises to improve cohesion within the diverse militaries in the alliance, as well as honing the skills of its crews.\n\nThe exercises will commence as soon as all federation fleets are in position.

entries.zh: 联合演习的准备工作完成
我们已为联邦联合军事演习做好万全准备，只需等待盟友的舰队就位，就可以开始行动！
entries.en: We are all set for the joint federation military exercises. We need merely wait for our allies' fleets to move into place before the operations begin!

entries.zh: 演习将在联邦舰队就位后立即开始。
entries.en: The exercises will commence as soon as all federation fleets are in position.

entries.zh: 所有联邦舰队现已就位，训练演习可立即开始！一组高机动性的轻装目标从先前隐藏的位置现身，在为期30天的演习中，这些目标会尽力避免被我们的舰船摧毁。
entries.en: All federation fleets are now in place, so the training exercises may commence! A set of lightly-armed but highly mobile targets have emerged from a previously hidden location and are seeking to avoid destruction by our ships before the 30 days time limit expires.

entries.zh: 武器已锁定目标并装填完毕！
我们已成功消灭联合军事演习中的目标。只能希望我们的盟友也同样勤奋！
entries.en: We have successfully eliminated our target in the joint military exercises. We can but hope that our allies have been equally diligent!

entries.zh: 我们未能消灭联合军事演习中的目标，舰队军官因此羞愧难当。我们只能希望盟友能够更加成功！
entries.en: To the immeasurable shame of our naval officers, we have failed to eliminate our target in the joint military exercises. We can only hope that our allies have been more successful!

entries.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习现已结束。这次演习称得上是鼓舞人心的巨大成功，每支参与演习的队伍都不费吹灰之力地摧毁了目标，彻底证明了我们联邦舰队超凡的技能和卓越的协调能力！在向我们开战前，敌人一定会再三考虑。
entries.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have now concluded. They have immediately been declared a rousing success, each participating fleet having struck down their targets without untoward difficulty, proving once and for all the excellent skill and superior coordination of our federation fleet! Our enemies will surely think twice before they pick a fight with us now.

entries.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习现已结束。这次演习相对来说差强人意：尽管并非所有舰队都能消灭其目标，但大部分参加的舰队都取得了成功，这说明联邦舰队有能力协调执行复杂的任务。此外，我们的船员也从这次经历中受益颇多，目前像往常一样准备充分，随时可以执行任务。在向我们开战前，敌人一定会再三考虑。
entries.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have now concluded. They have been declared a partial success: although not every party was able to eliminate their target, most participating fleets were able to do so, demonstrating that the federation's fleet is capable of coordinating to perform sophisticated tasks. Additionally, our crews have benefited greatly from the experience and are now as ready for action as ever before. Our enemies will surely think twice before they pick a fight with us now.

entries.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的军事演习现已结束，但过程有一点讽刺：尽管部分参加的舰队能够击中目标，但大多数舰队都未能成功，这让我们不禁怀疑，[Root.Federation.GetName]是否有能力组织统一的军事行动。我们只能希望敌人没有过于密切地关注演习的发展……
entries.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have ended in a slightly farcical manner: although some participants were able to strike their targets, a majority failed to do so, casting doubt on the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s ability to work as a unified force in military matters.  We can only hope that our enemies were not watching proceedings too closely...

entries.zh: 居然没有一个参加演习的成员国能在时限内消灭目标，[Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习也随之以闹剧告终。我们只能希望，在我们尽力捡起失去的骄傲、恢复舰队的尊严时，敌人没有过于密切地关注演习的发展。
entries.en: With the failure of even one participating member to eliminate their target before time ran out, the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have ended in farce. We can only hope that our enemies were not watching proceedings too closely as we seek to pick up the pieces of our lost pride and restore the dignity of our fleet.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队将所向披靡！

entries.en: We have the best of allies!

entries.zh: 至少我们完成了自己的目标。
entries.en: At least we did our part.

entries.zh: 我们垂头丧气，羞愧难当。
entries.en: We hang our heads in shame.

entries.zh: 联邦近期举行的训练演习展示了我们舰队高超的技能水平和卓越的协调能力。
entries.en: Recent training exercises organized by the federation have demonstrated the high skill level and excellent coordination of our fleets.

entries.zh: 近期的训练演习中，我们的军队在联邦舰队中表现不佳，并为此羞愧万分。
entries.en: Our military is ashamed at the poor performance of the federation's fleet during recent training exercises.

entries.zh: 参与联合军事演习受限
entries.en: Participation in Joint Military Exercises Curtailed

entries.zh: 我们已经离开了先前所在的联邦，因此我们无权参与其计划中的联合军事演习。
entries.en: As we have left our old federation, our participation in their planned joint military exercises has been curtailed.

entries.zh: 战争爆发导致计划中的联邦军事演习取消。
entries.en: The outbreak of war has led to the cancellation of the planned federation military exercises.

entries.zh: \n下列参演舰队未能完成演习：
entries.en: \nThe following participants failed to complete the exercises:

entries.zh: 虚境是否为神圣的次元？
entries.en: Is the Shroud a divine dimension?

entries.zh: 仅有唯一神明进行复数化身或是有复数神明？
entries.en: Is there a unique multifaceted god or many?
Is the Spirit separate from the Soul?
What does it take to be a Holy World?

entries.zh: 联合教会是否应有总主教？
entries.en: Should there be a global head of a unified Church?

entries.zh: 灵能是否为神触之力量？
entries.en: Are Psionics touched by the divine?

entries.zh: 什一税是否只应用于慈善？
entries.en: Should tithes only be used for charity?

entries.zh: 个人信仰是异端之源吗？
entries.en: Is private faith the root of heresy?

entries.zh: 弥赛亚审查。我们的救主是否仅为一名先知？
entries.en: The Messiah Review. Were our saviors merely prophets?

entries.zh: 泽珞族是否为神之信使？
我们自身是否蕴含着神圣？
entries.en: Is divinity contained within us or without us?

entries.zh: 何等美德可构成纯洁灵魂之基础？
entries.en: Which virtues are the foundations of a pure soul?

entries.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的成员们以圣灵之名汇聚一堂。我们在各自的信仰之间找到了共同点，但联邦内仍然还有着多种信条、宗教和教会，和谐共处并不容易。\n\n最近，僧团的成员敦促[Root.Federation.GetName]主持一场主教会议，以便共商起草一份联合教条，定义我们信仰的根基。这个提案被通过了，每一个[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员都要派出他们的代表。
entries.en: The members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] are united around their spirituality. We found common ground in the fact that we are believers, but the federation is home to various creeds, faiths and churches and cohabitation is sometimes uneasy.\n\nLately, members of the clergies have been pushing for the [Root.Federation.GetName] to hold an Ecumenical Council, where we could gather to try and outline a unified dogma, and define the core tenets of our beliefs. The idea was approved, and every member of the [Root.Federation.GetName] has been asked to send representatives.

entries.zh: 我们派往联邦的特使就能胜任
entries.en: Our envoy in the Federation can handle this

entries.zh: 简直莫名其妙。路上随便找群人派过去吧。
entries.en: This is nonsense. Only send a token delegation.

entries.zh: 我们对这个奇怪的议程不感兴趣。
entries.en: These peculiar proceedings do not concern us.

entries.zh: 今天的议题是“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”，我们的使团用最华丽的辞藻和无可辩驳的逻辑作出了一场令人印象深刻的陈辞，从气势上彻底碾压了那些反对者我们观点的声音。得益于我们的精彩表现，对手陷入了沉默并且会议很快得出结论。各国使团希望能因我们的智慧而给予嘉奖。
entries.en: During today's debates about "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", our delegation made a brilliant display of rhetoric and implacable logic, virtually crushing those arguing against our point of view. With the opposition silenced, a conclusion was swiftly reached thanks to us. Other delegations wish to honor us for our wisdom.

entries.zh: 我们来此不图名利。礼貌拒绝。
entries.en: We're not in this for prestige. Decline politely.

entries.zh: 这群笨蛋离了我们就是废物！
entries.en: These fools would get nothing done without us!
As if things could have gone any other way!

entries.zh: 关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”这个问题相当地微妙，相关的议论刺激着许多敏感的神经。具体来说，我们的使团非常固执己见，并且对各国的高级教士屡屡出言不逊。他们纷纷要求我们正式致歉。
entries.en: The question of "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" is a delicate one and many sensitivities where hurt in the discussions surrounding it. In particular, our delegation was most headstrong and has been recorded insulting several other high ranking prelates from other empires. They have requested an official apology from us.

entries.zh: 这种举止简直丢人。我们道歉。
entries.en: Actions like these are not acceptable. Apologize.

entries.zh: 一群煞笔！我们就是这样，怎么着。
entries.en: Dimwits all! We stand by what we said.

entries.zh: 显然一些小礼物应该能让他们理解个中缘由。
entries.en: Surely a few presents should help them to see reason.
Ecumenical Council: A Matter of Precedence

entries.zh: 在讨论“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”这个话题之前，议会要求使团们在一位高阶教士的领导下进行平静的冥想。由于议程制定不详细，有三位显赫的主教都认为他们自己才应当主持这场仪式。氛围变得焦灼了起来，随着他们争吵的升级，会议不得不延期举行。
entries.en: Before discussing the topic of "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", the delegations were supposed to be led in peaceful meditation by a high ranking prelate. Due to imprecisions in the schedule, three prominent priests thought that they would be the ones to lead the ceremony. The situation escalated and their bickerings have brought the council to a halt.

entries.zh: 哪个蠢货安排的议程？这会议简直就是个笑话。
entries.en: Who even organized this?! This council is a joke.

entries.zh: 这种事情不可接受。提出正式谴责。
entries.en: This behavior is unacceptable. Issue an official reprimand.

entries.zh: 重新安排议程，让他们几个获得想要的关注。
entries.en: Rearrange the schedule to give them the attention they seek.

entries.zh: 关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”的激烈讨论让每一位与会嘉宾都备受刺激情绪激动。为了缓和气氛，会议决定让每一个国家都互相交换礼物以及友谊的象征。我们要送些什么呢？
entries.en: The intense debates around "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" left everyone agitated and in high temper. To appease things, it has been decided that every empire shall offer gifts and tokens of friendship to the others. What should we send?
Present them with the sacred Imperial [GetSpeciesShavings].

entries.zh: 今日关于“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”的关键辩论被一位突然闯入的高级教士打断了，他拖着两位不同使团的成员。这两人被撞见时正在述说着对彼此跨越种族的恒久爱恋。较为保守的特使们认为他们的行为很不体面而且已经接近异端行为，有辱这场会议的神圣性。
entries.en: The day's crucial debate about "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]" was suddenly interrupted when a prelate came in, dragging along two members of different delegations. They were caught professing their undying love to each other, despite their differences. The more conservative envoys view their behavior as disrespectful and borderline heretical, violating the sanctity of this holy congress.
They are a symbol of unity!
Offer them a fast track to sacrifice.

entries.zh: 在激烈争论“[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]”一整天之后，按照其中一个使团的习俗举行了宴会。宴会的一个环节是向各位嘉宾呈上仪式性的酒水。对于那个使团的物种而言这是一种很弱的致幻剂，但对我们而言则反应强烈。仅过了一小会儿整个房间就陷入了混乱的斗殴中。所幸事态平息后没有人受到严重的伤害，但调查认为是我们的特使最先动的手，要求我们对此道歉。
entries.en: After a long day spent discussing "[GetEcumenicalCouncilDebate]", a feast was held following the custom of one of the delegations. As part of it, a ritual draught was served to everyone. To them, it is a mild inebriant, but our delegation had an extreme reaction to it, and moments later, the room erupted in a general brawl. Things have settled down and no major injuries have been reported, but we are regarded as having started the fight, and are expected to issue an apology.

entries.zh: 行，把他们全都送到一颗死寂星球静养去吧。
entries.en: Send everyone on a meditative retreat on a tomb world.

entries.zh: 在下决心主持会议时我们就知道，通向联合教条的路必定长满荆棘，但我们还是低谷了荆棘到底长得有多满。几个月毫无意义的争吵没有得出任何结论，反而是让我们更加意识到互相之间的不可调和。我们决定等过一段时间再提这事了。
entries.en: When we decided to hold the council, we knew the road to a unified dogma would be long and hard, but we underestimated just how long and how hard it would be. Months of sterile debates have done nothing but highlight everything that separates us from each other. We have decided to wait a while before trying again.

entries.zh: 我们确是受到眷顾的。最后发现，我们一开始忧心忡忡的事情不过是杞人忧天，一切进行得都无比丝滑。精准的理论和发人深省的演讲使我们成功地编撰出了和谐的新教条文集。我们很快会再重新修缮一回，但现在它已经成为了联合信仰的基础，拉近了彼此之间的距离！
entries.en: Truly, we are blessed. Whatever apprehensions we had going in have been proven wrong and everything went quite smoothly. Precise theology and inspired discourse have allowed us to create a harmonious corpus of our new dogma. We will surely revisit it later, but for now, it will serve as the foundation of a unified faith that will bring us closer to each other!

entries.zh: §G+20%§!岗位产出的£unity£凝聚力以及§G+3§!月度联邦经验值，维持20年。
entries.en: For 20 years, §G+20%§! £unity£ Unity from jobs and §G+3§! Monthly Federation XP

entries.zh: 总的来说，会议还是有所收获的。虽然不是完全顺利，但大家也都做好了面对困难的准备。这只是让我们的人民和信仰走向团结的第一步。道阻且长，但前途光明。
entries.en: Overall, the council was productive. Not everything went smoothly, but difficulties were to be expected. This is only the first step towards unifying our people and our faiths. The road will be long, but what expects us at the end will make it worthwhile.

entries.en: This Edict provides additional resources to §Y$building_medical_2$§! and §Y$building_medical_3$§! facilities.

我们必须建立一个新的家园，并从我们的母星上撤离。
entries.en: We must establish a new home and prepare to evacuate our homeworld.

entries.zh: 我们必须要求我们的劳工更加卖力干活。在上上善道面前，区区粉骨碎身又称得上什么。
entries.en: We must ask our workers to toil harder. A few broken bodies do not weigh much against the Greater Good.

entries.zh: 我们的子个体会更加勤勉地工作，因而需要更多资源。
entries.en: Our drones will be worked harder, as more resources are required.

entries.zh: 此法令可为孵化池提供额外资源。
entries.en: This Edict provides additional resources to the spawning pools.

entries.zh: 我们将利用基于点数的游戏化奖励机制，巧妙地鼓励活体陈设填满有机庇护所。
entries.en: Using gamification and point-based reward schemes, we will subtly encourage our Bio-Trophies to fill our Organic Sanctuaries.

entries.zh: 拥有§Y$building_organic_sanctuary$§!或§Y$building_organic_paradise$§!的行星获得§G+10%§!§Y人口增长§!。
保卫星系乃重中之重。此法令将为这些边塞之地调拨额外的资源。
entries.en: Defense of our systems is paramount. This Edict will direct additional resources to these ends.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队是投射武力的最佳途径。此法令将优先考虑舰队，将其置于其他次要需求之上。
entries.en: Our navy is our best means to project power. This Edict will prioritize them above lesser needs.

entries.zh: 成功可以通过获得的物资来衡量。此法令可为我们的工厂提供额外资源，以便提高产量。
entries.en: Success can be measured by the acquisition of things. This Edict provides our factories with additional resources so production can be increased.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国急需更加专业化的冶金和贵金属开采能力。这项法令为我们的合金铸造厂提供了额外的资源，使其生产能力进一步提高。
entries.en: Our empire thirsts for more specialized alloys and precious metals. This Edict provides our foundries with additional resources so production can be increased.

entries.zh: 知识就是力量。此法令将我们的工作重心放在科技发展上。
entries.en: Knowledge is power. This Edict focuses our efforts on advancing technology.

entries.zh: 与其吊死在此岸现世这一棵树上，不如为精神向导提供他们所需的一切，为未来做准备。
entries.en: Rather than focusing exclusively on this temporal world, we should provide our spiritual guides with whatever they need to prepare us for the next.
